chapters.title: Chapter 301 - I'll grant your wish
paragraphs: "Don't worry my son... I'll avenge you..." The patriarch of the Wang family, Wang Jiantian, squeezed his son's shoulders as they tore through the skies in the family's flying ship.
They were flying to the royal capital, accompanied by their family's personal guard: 100 powerful cultivators of the enlightened soul realm.
Wang Haoran heard his father's words, but his mind didn't even seem to compute the meaning.
His body had already recovered, at least almost all of it; his balls had been lost, as had his pride.
"No father... I'll kill him myself, I'll take those women... I won't accept such shame!" Haoran gritted his teeth, punching the table hard.
"Ah... just don't embarrass your father, okay?" Jiantian shook his head.
If his son was so sure of solving the problem himself, there was little he, as a father, could do other than support him.
After all, in Haoran's words, that enemy was just some transcendent.
The possibility of his son's defeat didn't even cross his mind.
"Sharpen your sword, I need some time to meditate." Jiantian said, raising his hand gently.
"Yes, father." Haoran left, his eyes full of fury as he headed for the back of the flying ship, where his family had a forge attached.

Unaware of that conversation, Qingyi walked through the streets of the capital of the Blue Sea Kingdom, full of powerful cultivators from all corners of the kingdom, all gathered for one thing: the great annual auction of the Five Colors Pavilion.
This auction was only a few hours away from starting and Qingyi knew full well that if he didn't hurry soon, he would probably miss his chance to place his bid.
Still, he didn't worry, walking calmly.
He had prepared around ten pills in total.

Six were affinity enhancement pills, one was a spirit root enhancement pill and the other, a lineage and constitution enhancement pill, all capable of raising the quality of these things to mortal grade.
The latter, however, were what gave him so much confidence that his items would be accepted easily, even at short notice.

A lineage and constitution enhancement pill and a spiritual root enhancement pill, both capable of raising these to earth grade, a level that many geniuses in the Blue Sea Kingdom could only dream of reaching.
Shaking his head, he entered the main building of the Five Colors Pavilion.
"Good morning, young master. What can I do for you?" An attendant approached Qingyi, bowing respectfully.
"I want to register a valuable item for the auction." Qingyi replied and after a short moment, the attendant nodded, leading him into the waiting room.
Qingyi had to go through a brief check, waiting a few minutes until it was his turn to meet one of the many managers taking care of collecting items for the auction.
He was a middle-aged man in gray robes, his dark eyes sweeping Qingyi disinterestedly.
In his mind, this was just another young dreamer, believing that his trash was treasure.
He was already ready to refuse Qingyi's items when the young man finally revealed them. A small black box, carrying exactly ten pills in its padded interior.
The manager froze, his eyes wide and his heart racing. His eyesight wasn't lying to him, was it?
"Y-young man... do you know the value of these items?" The manager asked, using his most powerful identification technique, studying those items carefully.
They were real, true pills capable of improving talent.
"Yes, senior. This junior would like to present them for auction." Qingyi replied respectfully, but didn't bow.
"Well..." The manager swallowed. "We can accept them at a ten percent commission rate, placing them as intermediate items..."
"I understand..." Qingyi replied, scratching his chin for a brief moment before standing up and picking up the box. "I'm sorry for wasting senior's time."
The manager was initially relaxed, but seeing Qingyi grab the door handle, he despaired.
Those items were so rare that they were comparable to ancestral heirlooms, he couldn't lose them!
"Wait, five percent!" The manager shouted, but Qingyi didn't even seem to hear him, opening the door.
"Three percent, no... two percent! Two percent commission and a place for the two best pills among the final items! The other pills will be sold among the intermediate items.
Hearing those words, Qingyi finally stopped.
"Please, this is the most I can offer." The manager spoke, watching Qingyi with a pleading look.
"I'm glad the manager has finally decided to show some sincerity..." Qingyi smiled, taking his seat at the table again.
He had expected that not all the pills would get a place in the final batch, but that didn't really matter.
From Ruxue and Meilin's words, such items were basically non-existent in the immortal heavens, so their value was incalculable.
As long as the two pills capable of reaching earth grade were revealed in the final batch, nothing else mattered.
Exchanging handshakes with the manager, Qingyi's items were registered.
All he had to do was sign a blood contract with the Five Colors Pavilion and then he could leave, receiving a VIP token free of charge to attend the auction.
He just wanted to find a secluded place to enter the world of the mind and spend some time with his wives until the auction started, but his plans suddenly broke down.
On the horizon, he saw an arrogant figure, walking alongside a powerful entourage and a cultivator from the False Immortal realm.
That was the young master of the City of Howling Winds, Wang Haoran.
Haoran's eyes also met Qingyi's, his whole body locking up as his face was filled with fury.
[You coward... if you have the courage, meet me in the forest north of the royal capital, I'll duel you and wash away this shame!"]. Haoran sent a sound transmission to Qingyi.
[If you want to lose more than your balls so badly, I'll grant your wish. Soften your teeth in advance so it'll be easier to pull them out]. Qingyi smiled arrogantly.
Despite the difference in cultivation, he wasn't afraid.

chapters.title: Chapter 302 - Auction(01)
paragraphs: As night fell, the streets of the capital of the Blue Moon Kingdom became more and more crowded.
Thousands of onlookers surrounded the Five Colors Pavilion auction house.
The venue was large enough to accommodate more than fifty thousand people in its lower stands alone, which surrounded a large jade stage in a perfect circle.
The VIP boxes, just above, held another thousand people: masters of great sects, powerful experts, representatives of noble houses and, of course, the royal family.
Qingyi was in one of these boxes, not as luxurious as those intended for the high nobility, but still comfortable.
Next to him on the large sofa was Meilin. Her beautiful porcelain face bore an uncomfortable expression.
Even with the great distance between her VIP room and her brother's, on the opposite side of the auction house, she could still feel his angry gaze.
Of course, she wasn't afraid. She was under Qingyi's protective embrace and her brother couldn't do anything against her, at least not openly.

None of his men would be crazy enough to openly raise a hand against a beloved daughter of the Golden King and, honestly, if her father hadn't laid down such stupidly antiquated rules, she would probably have regained her position by now.
In the end, she could only sigh, clinging to Qingyi and closing her eyes for a brief moment, allowing herself to relax.
The handsome young man was also calm, hugging Meilin while his eyes roamed around the other cabins.
Among them were the two princes.
The third prince's box was to the right of the branch leader's box: a handsome man with blond hair and fine eyes, almost always closed, his lips curved in a subtle smile.
The second prince's cabin was on the left: a brutish man in silver armor and short hair, his cultivation from the peak of the False Immortal Realm subtly leaking out, falling onto his brother's box.
It was quite clear that they hated each other.
The third prince gritted his teeth, also releasing his aura, an icy Qi hitting the second prince's flaming Qi.
"You dare?" The second prince slammed the table in front of his chair, ready to increase the power of his Qi even more, but his momentum died in the next moment.
"Behave yourselves." An grunt echoed out; serene, masculine and calm, but carrying a strange, sickly aura in the ancestral Qi that enveloped it.
Many of the weaker ones there shuddered at hearing that voice, and Qingyi's eyes followed its origin.
Above everyone and everything was a gold-coated box, its interior completely darkened so that those who occupied it could not be seen.
That was the box destined for the king, the queen and no one else.
Bowing their heads, the two princes stopped fighting and sat down comfortably under their father's gaze.
"Good evening, inestimable guests!" A cheerful voice rang out, calming everyone's spirits.
From the top of the auction house, a beautiful female figure appeared, floating subtly, her black hair elegantly tied up while her red-painted lips displayed a gentle smile.

"The Five Colors Pavilion branch in the Blue Sea Kingdom welcomes Your Majesty, Your Highnesses and everyone to one of our biggest auctions since our establishment in the Blue Sea Kingdom many centuries ago."
She declared, bowing towards the royal box.
Extending her hand slightly, a small golden stick appeared in her hand.
Pointing this stick towards the center of the platform, she smiled. "To begin our auction, some appetizers."
The moment her voice ceased, the ground beneath her feet shook, slowly opening up to reveal a collection of exactly ten items, covered in black tents.
These were the cheapest items in the auction, barely tens of thousands of Superior Qi crystals.
Qingyi wasn't really interested in any of it, just waiting for the Feiyan pills, but Ruxue's voice echoing in his head made him change his mind.

"Qingyi... I can sense something in the third item, it's probably one of my fragments." The spiritual beauty spoke, her eyes shining in the world of the mind as she observed the world through Qingyi's eyes.
Obviously, he was excited by this too, taking a look at his reserve of superior Qi crystals and lust points before sighing in defeat.
He only had around 600 high-level spirit crystals, with enough lust points to buy another 2,000.
No item in that auction would come that cheap, not even in Qingyi's dreams.
"Something interests you? My brother cleared out my bank reserves, but I still had some change with me in my space ring." Meilin asked, watching her husband's gaze.
Without even waiting for Qingyi's reply, Meilin pressed her space ring against his, transferring all her wealth.
"Thanks, I'll repay you nicely, hehehe..." Qingyi smiled, slapping Meilin's ass hard and kissing her gently before taking a look at her spirit ring.
'change?' he wondered. 'There are over a hundred thousand spirit crystals here, where does this woman think this is change?'
Tang Biyue was like that too. Rich people were truly crazy.
With a subtle smile, the auctioneer lifted the first item, revealing a beautiful long sword, a brittle item of little value to anyone who wasn't a collector.
Even so, it was snapped up by a minor sect leader who paid just over thirty thousand Superior Qi crystals.
The second item was a defensive artifact in the shape of a necklace, capable of creating barriers powerful enough to withstand even attacks from experts at the peak of the Enlightened Soul Realm.
This was auctioned off for over fifty thousand by the second prince.
"Now for the third item." The auctioneer lifted the curtain, revealing a small piece of purplish silver metal.
"It looks like just an ordinary piece of steel, but not even the most renowned blacksmith in our pavilion was able to melt it down. The opening bid will be 10,000 Qi crystals."
'It really is a fragment of Ruxue...' Qingyi perked up and the moment the first bid echoed, he held up a small plaque.
"50,000!" He silenced all the other interested parties, all but one.
He was already certain of his victory when Wang Haoran stood up, sending a deadly smile at the handsome young man as he held up his father's plaque. "120,000!"

chapters.title: Chapter 303 - Auction (02)
paragraphs: 'Son of a bitch...' Qingyi cursed mentally, clenching his fists, his eyes filled with a fury that hadn't seized his body for a long time.
That look, full of contempt and arrogance.
He would rip it off Wang Haoran's face, skin and all.
[Just to make sure you don't chicken out and run away, duel me after the auction if you want this item!] A sound transmission reached Qingyi.
It was from Haoran, who expected to see Qingyi shudder and cower.
But that's not what happened, quite the opposite.
Qingyi's lips opened in a big smile, a weight being lifted from his heart.
He had already forgotten Haoran's challenge.
He hadn't lost anything, quite the opposite. He would beat an asshole to death and on top of that, he would win a new Ruxue fragment.
And he wouldn't have to spend a single penny for it!
He was truly a man blessed by heaven, both with his wives and with his enemies.

'Don't worry, Brother Haoran... I'll read fate to find out who your future wife is and sleep with her after I've finished with you, I'll be sure to repay your kindness...' Qingyi declared mentally, his heart filled with gratitude.
What a noble and kind man Wang Haoran was...
Shaking his head, Qingyi focused his eyes back on the auction.
It didn't take long for the first items to be sold, with the second batch soon arriving.
These were already items of much higher quality, some selling for hundreds of thousands.
An earth-grade sword went for over two million to the third prince, and a space ring capable of holding up to five thousand cubic meters was bought for four million by the Wang family.

"This will go to my son, in commemoration of his recent breakthrough to the ethereal body realm, one of the youngest of his generation!" The family patriarch declared loudly, handing the ring to Wang Haoran.
Qingyi watched it all, lowering his head slightly.
Even a space ring for him... was there no end to the Wang family's kindness? How did they know he needed a new space ring?
Qingyi sighed, unable to make any promises worth all the kindness the Wang family was showing him.
In the end, all he could do was lean back in his chair, feeling Meilin's squeeze against him grow even stronger.
Time passed quickly as hundreds of items were sold and soon, it was time for the Feiyan pills.
Qingyi even regretted a little that he hadn't brought the tanned beauty with him.
Knowing how much she loved money, he was sure she would love this auction.
"For the last item in the penultimate batch, we have something that is sure to excite many here..." The auctioneer flashed an elegant smile.
"Pills, but not ordinary pills. Pills capable of raising spiritual roots, affinities and even lineages and constitutions!
Their value alone isn't much, but their purity is so extreme that the process of reverse engineering could easily lead to the discovery of their production method.
Think of an army of geniuses, just yours."
The moment the auctioneer's voice ceased, the whole auction erupted in murmurs.
Even the king's box became slightly louder as the pills were unveiled.
Mortal-grade talent wasn't much, even though they were already considered geniuses. But the purity of those pills changed everything.
Between 92 and 95%, with such a high purity, the chances of reverse engineering those pills skyrocketed.
"The opening bid is one hundred-"
"Five hundred thousand!" Before the auctioneer's voice had even finished, one of the richest nobles in the kingdom stood up.
"One million!" The second prince stood up immediately afterwards.
"Two million!" The third prince also stood up.
If they could get those pills and the methods to mass-produce them... their armies would be unstoppable.
It didn't take more than a few moments for the amount to pass five million, each bid more aggressive than the last.
Many nobles wanted it for personal reasons, while the princes mainly wanted it to stop it falling into each other's hands.
It was only when the bids passed ten million that they suddenly stopped, an ancient voice echoing through the auction room.
"Fifteen million.
The moment that bid echoed, everyone bowed their heads.
It came from the king himself. Even those who had the wealth to contest it decided it was better not to.
Slowly, the pills left the platform, floating up to the royal box.
The auctioneer didn't lose her professionalism, her hips swaying gently as she unveiled the last batch, containing exactly five items.
"Don't be sad about missing out on the last item... not when you still have the chance to get these rare pills to create great geniuses." She revealed a small box with two golden pills inside.
The moment the first experts felt the aura exuded by those pills, before she even announced the price, the first bid was placed.
"Ten million!" The patriarch of the Wang family stood up, his bid quickly being covered by the patriarch of another wealthy family.
Qingyi glanced at Meilin's beautiful face from the corner of his eye, watching her eyes light up as the bids passed thirty million.
Even considering the ability to create an earth-grade genius, she hadn't imagined they'd get that much money.
"Thank you husband! I'll make you the richest man in the entire immortal heaven." Meilin hugged Qingyi, kissing him passionately.
"Even richer than your father?" The handsome young man smiled, slapping Meilin's plump, shapely ass, feeling the voluptuous flesh ripple with shock.
"Nghn~~ second richest..." Meilin blushed.
"Hahaha!" Qingyi laughed, the bidding for his item stopping just short of forty million, being snapped up by the King again.

With enough wealth to help Meilin get on her feet, now all Qingyi had to do was knock a few teeth out of that young master of the Wang family, also accepting the gifts that they had so kindly bought for Qingyi.
Jin Tianshi, Meilin's brother, naturally noticed her happiness at seeing that bid, his face distorting as he called for a servant.
"Find out who put those pills up for auction, now!"
"But young master... your father forbids it-"
"I don't care, I'm the one who pays your salary, so fucking obey!"
The servant bowed his head and left.

"Two million!" The third prince also stood up.
If they could get those pills and the methods to mass-produce them... their armies would be unstoppable.
It didn't take more than a few moments for the amount to pass five million, each bid more aggressive than the last.
Many nobles wanted it for personal reasons, while the princes mainly wanted it to stop it falling into each other's hands.
It was only when the bids passed ten million that they suddenly stopped, an ancient voice echoing through the auction room.
"Fifteen million.
The moment that bid echoed, everyone bowed their heads.
It came from the king himself.
Even those who had the wealth to contest it decided it was better not to.
Slowly, the pills left the platform, floating up to the royal box.
The auctioneer didn't lose her professionalism, her hips swaying gently as she unveiled the last batch, containing exactly five items.
"Don't be sad about missing out on the last item... not when you still have the chance to get these rare pills to create great geniuses." She revealed a small box with two golden pills inside.
The moment the first experts felt the aura exuded by those pills, before she even announced the price, the first bid was placed.
"Ten million!" The patriarch of the Wang family stood up, his bid quickly being covered by the patriarch of another wealthy family.
Qingyi glanced at Meilin's beautiful face from the corner of his eye, watching her eyes light up as the bids passed thirty million.
Even considering the ability to create an earth-grade genius, she hadn't imagined they'd get that much money.
"Thank you husband!
I'll make you the richest man in the entire immortal heaven." Meilin hugged Qingyi, kissing him passionately.
"Even richer than your father?" The handsome young man smiled, slapping Meilin's plump, shapely ass, feeling the voluptuous flesh ripple with shock.
"Nghn~~ second richest..." Meilin blushed.
"Hahaha!" Qingyi laughed, the bidding for his item stopping just short of forty million, being snapped up by the King again.

With enough wealth to help Meilin get on her feet, now all Qingyi had to do was knock a few teeth out of that young master of the Wang family, also accepting the gifts that they had so kindly bought for Qingyi.
Jin Tianshi, Meilin's brother, naturally noticed her happiness at seeing that bid, his face distorting as he called for a servant.
"Find out who put those pills up for auction, now!"
"But young master... your father forbids it-"
"I don't care, I'm the one who pays your salary, so fucking obey!"
The servant bowed his head and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 304 - Fight or flee, worm.
paragraphs: In total, Feiyan's pills sold for 55 million crystals of superior Qi, enough to keep the world of the mind running at full power for many years.
Even after fees, 5% national and 2% from the auction house, there was still around 51,150,000 left for Qingyi.
Wealth that, after redeeming, he handed over to Meilin, leaving the auction house and placing her in Ruxue's world of the mind.
"The bastard with my fragment is moving..." Ruxue's voice echoed in Qingyi's mind, who nodded silently, hurrying towards the northern part of the city.
Stopping briefly, he looked back and activated his draconic eyes.
He could see strange movements of Qi, but there didn't seem to be anyone following him.
Sighing and shaking his head, he moved on, leaving the city walls and heading for the vast forest in the northern region.
On the horizon, he saw a pillar of flame rise briefly.
"This idiot is even using flares... he must be excited to get his ass whooped." Qingyi smiled, activating the lightning flash.
His body transformed into lightning as he tore through the forest at absurd speed, quickly arriving at a wide clearing where he saw two figures.
Wang Haoran, young master of the Wang family, his hands firmly gripping his long, elegant saber.
Beside him, a shadowy figure, protected by heavy armor and exuding a powerful Qi.
'Early enlightened soul realm...' Qingyi whispered, looking around.
Fortunately, there were only the two of them, but it still wasn't going to be an easy fight.
"Has you finally shown yourself? Coward!" Haoran roared, showing off the fragment he had bought at the auction. "That's what you want, isn't it?"
"For someone who brought help to a one-on-one duel, you really love calling others cowards, don't you? Just don't go running off and crying to your daddy."
Qingyi giggled, the heaven-defying thunder sword sliding out of its sheath with a sharp hiss.
"Come to me, alone or both, I don't care. But know that I won't be as pious as my wife, I won't stop at just turning you into a woman.
Hearing those words, Haoran's body shuddered, his eyes filling with rage. "You're going to die here!"
"Let's see." Qingyi swung his sword, his body turning into a blur as he advanced, using the first form of the Tempest Monarch's sword art.
His blade hit Haoran's with a thud, the ground beneath his feet cracking for dozens of meters.
"Damn you!" Haoran roared, gritting his teeth, his wind Qi colliding with Qingyi's wind Qi.
He forced his muscles to the limit, pulling out every drop of Qi and pushing it all towards his opponent.
With the difference in cultivation, how could he not expect an easy victory?
Unfortunately, the difference wasn't big enough. His feet tore the ground as he was slowly pushed back, Qingyi's thunderous Qi spreading across his blade and tearing the skin of his hand.
"Fuck!" Haoran finally retreated, unable to bear the pain and falling to his knees.
Obviously, it was incomparable to the pain of having his testicles twisted, but it was still horrible.
"This young man seems to have a strange lineage, should I intervene, Young Master Wang?" The guard asked, bowing gently.
Behind Qingyi's back, the huge figure of a black dragon watched them coldly. Even the guard felt his cultivation being suppressed, a sense of danger taking over his body.

"No... I'll defeat him alone!" Haoran punched the ground, advancing towards Qingyi again, his body splitting into dozens of identical images, each covered in wind Qi and pointing their blades at the handsome young man.

"Interesting technique..." Qingyi spoke, using the second and third forms of the Storm Monarch's sword art in succession, already preparing the fourth, dozens of ethereal thunder blades surrounding his body.
"Your cheap tricks won't stop my family's secret technique!" Haoran roared, all the ethereal images advancing towards Qingyi at the same time, attacking from all angles.
Meanwhile, he finally used his law, the temperature around Qingyi quickly reaching thousands of degrees Celsius.
Qingyi could only cover his body with black scales, the ethereal blades surrounding his body also advancing, colliding with the images formed by Haoran.
They remained in that stalemate for long seconds, the ground beneath their feet shaking as Qingyi's patience ran out.
Haoran was an annoying enemy, not only unable to shut up for a moment, but also hiding among the dozens of images formed by that strange wind technique.
"I think I've seen enough." Qingyi stretched out his hand, also calling for his law.
A small gray flame formed on the tip of his finger, lasting for a brief moment before spreading out in a violent explosion, consuming everything around him.
"FUCK!" A heartbreaking scream echoed as Haoran left the sea of gray flames.
All the Qi outside his body had been consumed, his arm burnt to the bone as the flames continued to rise.
Just before reaching his shoulder, the guard acted, swinging his blade towards Haoran's arm, cutting it off.
He managed to stop the flames from reaching Haoran's torso, but not from climbing onto his sword, forcing him to throw it away.
That was a powerful spirit sword that he had gotten as a gift from the captain of the Wang family guard as soon as he reached the enlightened soul realm.
Even so, under Qingyi's flames, the steel surrounded by protective spiritual matrices immediately melted, soon turning to ash.
"Ugh... fuck, what are you waiting for? Kill that son of a bitch!" Haoran whimpered, grabbing what was left of his arm.
"Yes, young master." The guard's eyes took on a deadly hue as he took a step forward, feeling the dragon's gaze behind Qingyi as he took another sword from his spatial ring.
Now that it was focused on him, he had to admit that that lineage projection was truly frightening, his power suppressed to a fraction of what it was before.
"Young man, hand over your head and the Wang family promises a quick death." The guard overcame the hesitation in his heart, readying his blade.
"Uh... since when does the Wang family allow insects to make threats in their place? Fight or flee, worm."

chapters.title: Chapter 305 - Don't worry, Young Master Wang
paragraphs: The realm of the enlightened soul was quite... different.
It didn't improve the body, nor the soul, nor the Qi, at least not as the main part.
Obviously, even realms focused entirely on the soul still work a little on building a strong body.
The realm of the enlightened soul, despite its name, only worked with one thing: Affinities and control.
An illumination took place in the mind sea, which was then rebuilt as the cultivator entered a trance-like state that allowed them to greatly increase their understanding of cultivation.
This was something that Qingyi immediately understood as he exchanged blows with the guard.
For the first time since fighting the leader of the demon cult, he felt his muscles ignite, his meridians burning as he forced all his Qi out, taking a step back with each exchange of blows.
Three entire cultivation realms were truly too much for Qingyi, at least at the current level of his lineage and constitution.
Still, he didn't let himself be discouraged, using his law with full force to force the guard back, taking advantage of every small opening to attack.
"You're good, kid, your talent and your law are incomparable to anything I've ever seen. But you're too arrogant." The guard spoke, his blade striking Qingyi's.

Yes, even in the Enlightened Sky Empire, one could count on one's fingers the number of geniuses who could hold their own against an Enlightened Soul Realm cultivator being only at the Ascension Realm.
"No, I'm just arrogant enough." Qingyi flashed a big smile, finally revealing his ice Qi, an icy tsunami leaving his feet towards the guard's feet, pinning him in place.
"What? How?" The guard's eyes went wide and he soon realized something: he wasn't managing to break through that ice - no, his Qi flow to his legs had stopped completely!
When he looked down, his eyes filled with terror.
That ice Qi was engulfed in gray flames!
"Burn in peace." Qingyi stepped back, a flaming spear appearing in his hands, illuminating the world around him.
The guard barely had time to compute the pain before the first spear hit his chest, tearing through his armor, flesh and bones, exploding and opening a huge crater.
"N-no... impossible..." Young Master Haoran whispered, guts, flesh and blood falling from the sky, carried away by the explosion.
Qingyi had just killed a cultivator of the enlightened soul realm?
Even if it was just a guard who had just made a breakthrough, he still refused to believe it.
"Ah..." Qingyi sighed, cracking his neck and looking at his hands.
They were shaking and under the skin, he could feel his meridians burning.
That was normal when you used up a lot of Qi in a short space of time, but even so, his meridians should already be recovering.
What was taking him so long?
"You're using your law too recklessly. It's natural for such powerful laws to have side effects on your body. Only use it in emergencies," Ruxue's voice echoed in Qingyi's mind.
"I understand..." He shook his head.
In fact, he felt his meridians suffer much more when he used his law.
Putting it out of his mind, he focused his eyes on Haoran.
"Looks like we'll finally be able to solve our problems, huh? Little cuckold Haoran..." Qingyi knelt down, pointing a single finger towards Haoran's remaining arm.
A powerful sword Qi appeared, cutting Haoran's arm off, the link to the spatial ring also disappearing.
Qingyi took it immediately, putting it on his finger and observing the richness inside.
Qingyi's beautiful dark eyes were soon filled with an intense glow.
So many high-quality cultivation pills, so many spiritual materials... Young Master Wang had really prepared a great gift for him.
Taking the fragment of the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword, Qingyi brought it close to the sword, watching as the blade swallowed it up.
[Item "Heaven-defying Thunder Sword" has been upgraded: Mortal Grade -> Earth Grade]
The Heaven-defying Thunder Sword flickered violently, its blade becoming much sharper than ever.
The few defects that still showed on it's steel it were completely erased, revealing a perfect blade of beauty not inferior to the spirit of lightning that inhabited it.

"Ah... Young master Wang was so good to me..." Qingyi shook his head. "Young masters like you always have arranged marriages, don't they? Don't worry, Young Master Wang, I'll find your future wife and make her the happiest woman in the world!"
"N-no, bastard, don't you dare!" A final cry of despair from Wang Haoran echoed before Qingyi cut off his head.
Many kilometers from that gloomy forest, the royal palace was bustling, especially in a luxurious meeting room, where two fake immortals were chatting.

"My son may have been castrated, I understand your concern, third prince. But we need to keep the marriage going, the first princess, your sister, needs a good man just as you need my armies." The patriarch of the Wang family spoke.
In front of him, the prince relaxed and drank from a glass of wine.
"It's not just about me, you know."
The third prince shook his head.
"Father wouldn't allow my little sister to be with a man incapable of fathering offspring and even if my father wasn't in a position to meddle, my brother still wouldn't allow such a marriage."
"But-" The Wang family patriarch opened his mouth, but it fell shut the next moment, a subtle glow spreading through the ring on his finger.
"Haoran..." He whispered only once before realizing the gravity of the warning.
His body exploded in power as he stood up, jumping out of a window and flying towards the horizon.
He landed kilometers away, a crash raising dust in all directions.
"My Haoran..." He knelt over his son's corpse.
How could it be possible? How could his Haoran have lost to some transcendent?
He was so confident...
"Hm... looks like we really won't have a wedding." The third prince chuckled, feeling the residual Qi.
One in the ethereal body realm and one in the enlightened soul realm, fighting against one in the ascension realm.
He thought for a brief moment before laughing, erasing Qingyi's residual Qi before Patriarch Wang was able to sense it.
"An interesting young fellow has just appeared in the Kingdom."

paragraphs: "Ah... it's good that I got out of there quickly..." Qingyi looked back, feeling that powerful Qi exploding on the horizon.
A scream full of hatred echoed along with this Qi, tearing through the skies.
Even from many kilometers away, the Qi of that false immortal was still terrifying.
Shaking his head, Qingyi just walked on, disappearing into the crowd walking down the wide central street of the royal capital.
'Any change?' Qingyi asked Ruxue.
'Not much,' her sweet, mature voice echoed in his mind. "I'm stronger, much stronger, but this fragment didn't have much function other than structural."
'I see...' Qingyi scratched his chin before entering a humble hotel, renting a small room and lying down to enter the world of the mind.
The moment he stepped through the great gates of the temple, Xueyao's excited voice reached his ears: "Oh... there are so many crystals!"
Turning his face, Qingyi saw a huge pile of spirit crystals on the ground.
Feiyan was lying on them, her arms open wide as she made little angels in riches incomparable to anything she had ever seen in her life.
Approaching Ruxue and Meilin, two loud slaps echoed, followed by high-pitched squeals.

"Let me guess, it was Feiyan's idea to throw all this on the floor?" Qingyi smiled, pulling them both into his embrace. One of his hands sank into Ruxue's huge breasts while the other went down to Meilin's plump, perfectly round ass cheeks, squeezing gently.
"Mhn~~ Who else would it be?" Ruxue giggled, drawing a long sigh from Qingyi.

Cheerfully, she took up position on Qingyi's lap, feeding her husband under the envious gazes of the other wives.

"You..." Meilin's eyes widened before she sighed. "Young Master Wang deserved it."

"We should go to the far south, a place where my brother still doesn't have much control. It's also territory far from the capital's affairs. With that money and a few contacts, we could start a chamber of commerce there. We could even find ships and try to sell some things to the Land of Beasts."
"Beast Land?" Qingyi repeated, remembering this name from somewhere. His eyes focused on Xueyao.
The Land of Beasts was Xueyao's place of origin, and he had promised that one day he would take her back there.
"Is it near here? How powerful are the experts in that region?" asked Qingyi.
"Hm..." Meilin thought for a moment before waving her hand, causing a map to emerge from her spatial ring and spread through the air.

The Kingdom of the Blue Sea was on a peninsula at the most south-westerly point of the continent, while the Land of Beasts was in a region surrounded by mountains and ridges. Still in the south, but tens of thousands of kilometers away.
"I don't know much about their power, but once an entourage of them visited my father in the Enlightened Capital. There was at least one cultivator from the Ancestral Emperor Realm among them."
Hearing that, Qingyi nodded, remembering the Qi he had felt from Haoran's father, a false immortal.
How powerful would one of the most powerful beings in the Immortal Heaven, an Ancestral Emperor?
Unfortunately, he couldn't think about it for long. Just after they had finished their meal, he found himself being grabbed by delicate, possessive hands.

chapters.title: Chapter 310 - Blasphemy
paragraphs: Qingyi followed Margareth's voluptuous figure in silence, his eyes roaming over her delicate back and the gentle sway of her hips, sending ripples across her round, perky bubblebutt.
There were no guards protecting her and the few knights below her seemed unconcerned about allowing Qingyi, a complete stranger, to be alone by her side.
After all, despite her delicate appearance, she was a powerful sixth-ring mage, and a very talented one at that.
Of course, Qingyi himself wouldn't dare do anything against her, not now.
She wasn't like that guard who accompanied the Wang family's young master; a newcomer to the enlightened soul realm with only slightly above-average talent.
Margareth was truly a powerhouse of the sixth ring, probably second in power only to enlightened soul realm cultivators with bloodlines.
Margareth passed through the large double doors of the lord's mansion, stopping suddenly.
Her fingers brushed a lock of golden hair out of her face as she watched a small army gathered outside.
Around five hundred men in total. There were a few cultivators among them, but the vast majority were mana users.
Naturally, she didn't have time to spend on any pomp. Those pirates were like rats, constantly changing their hiding places, never staying in one place for more than a few days.
They needed to act as quickly as possible.
It didn't take more than thirty minutes before they left the protection of the Eagle Peak Valley walls, marching in two separate lines along the closed trails.
Qingyi walked silently alongside the soldiers, his eyes filled with nostalgia.
He wasn't marching in formation, nor was he obliged to do so, but standing next to them, he couldn't help remembering his life on earth.
The three years he'd spent in the army had been a living hell, but at least he'd learned a lot.
"You're new here, aren't you?" A voice echoed next to Qingyi, coming from a young soldier, one of the locals who had converted to the Auranys faith.
"Yes," Qingyi replied, "I come from the capital."

"Oh..." The young man's eyes twinkled softly. "I've heard that the capital is huge. Is it true that there are millions of people there? Are you here to convert to Auranys too? Her light reaches us all!
"Well..." Qingyi sighed, shaking his head.
A religious fanatic. Honestly, what else could you expect? Even cultivators were fanatical in a way, but they worshipped the heavens, not a specific deity.
And this worship of the heavens also took place in a very different way.
"Maybe if she was hot..." He whispered, imagining the appearance of such a goddess.
She wouldn't be ugly, would she?
Qingyi barely had time to look away before he was forced to dodge a punch, the soldier's fist passing inches from his face.
"What a blasphemy! How dare you!" The soldier punched again, stopping those marching behind.
"Kid..." A touch of anger appeared on Qingyi's face as he parried the young man's fist. A thin thread of murderous intent left his body.
"If you do that again," Qingyi brought his face close to the young soldier, squeezing so hard that a grunt of pain echoed, "I'll make you see your goddess much faster than you can imagine."
"Is there a problem?" One of the knights overseeing the march approached, his horse slowing down, his powerful mana falling on them both.
The soldier almost fell to his knees while Qingyi just shook his head, continuing to walk.
"N-no, Sir Sillas..." The soldier also resumed walking, holding his aching wrist as he struggled to erase that frightening image of Qingyi from his mind.
Many kilometers from the Eagle Peak Valley, there was a colossal, isolated cave, with the sea invading it through a wide, high passage.
Inside, more than ten ships could be seen, all carrying black flags, moored to a makeshift pier. Hundreds of pirates were camping there.
"What do you think of this place?" An aged, soft voice echoed from one of the deepest parts of the cave, where the ocean poured into a deep, violent stream.
It was a man who looked to be in his sixties, with an aged face and a long red beard.

"It's well hidden, but too confined. If anyone breaks in, we'll be like pigs in a slaughterhouse." Another man replied, plunging his hand into the stream, having to protect it with Qi so that the violence of the water wouldn't tear his skin.
This man was like the first, but with a black beard and a deep, flawed voice.
These two were brothers who had founded their pirate group and, together, had terrorized those waters for countless years.
The one with the red beard was in the early flowing meridian realm, while the one with the black beard was at the peak of the enlightened soul realm.
"You think too much, brother. Honestly, you should worry more about finding a way to capture that arrogant bitch. We need a good quality woman, a real good one!"
Redbeard laughed, his face flushing as he remembered the only direct clash his group had had with the golden-haired beauty.
He wouldn't have minded losing his cock just for the chance to have a night with a woman of that level.
"Ah..." Blackbeard just sighed, shaking his head.
He liked women, but he wasn't a lustful man, not compared to his brother.
"Come on, the slaves must have prepared lunch by now. We'll stay here for another week and then we'll leave," said Blackbeard, getting up.
His brother led the way as they made their way to the main part of the cave.
Redbeard barely took a single step out of the tunnel they were in before his whole body locked up.
A powerful explosion echoed and the whole cave shook violently.
"Filthy pigs... you'll pay for giving me so much trouble and hindering my magical research!"
A hate-filled roar echoed and, behind Redbeard, all Blackbeard could see was a powerful flash of light and a scorching heat.

chapters.title: Chapter 311 - Blackbeard
paragraphs: Blackbeard covered his body with metallic Qi as a fireball hit the tunnel entrance.
A wave of extreme heat, capable of melting steel, crashed into him.
When the heat ceased and he opened his eyes, he saw only his brother's corpse, completely charred, torn into dozens of pieces by the force of the explosion.
With trembling steps, he came out of the tunnel and saw the figure of a beautiful woman with golden hair. Balls of fire danced in her hands , before falling on the pirates below.
At the same time, hundreds of soldiers burst through the only land passage, bringing more death to the pirates.
"You..." Blackbeard gritted his teeth, his face filled with a crazed rage and a powerful murderous intent. "You dare hurt my brother?" he roared, bringing out a large axe in his hands.
Margareth immediately sensed the danger. Five translucent barriers appeared in sequence around her body.
"DIE!" Blackbeard launched himself at her like an enraged beast. His axe hit the first barrier, shattering it like a glass cup.
The same happened with the second, third and fourth barriers.
Only at the last one did Margareth finally release all her mana, managing to stop the attack.
"Push!" she shouted in a strange language. The wind around her created a powerful shockwave, sending Blackbeard flying away.
Simultaneously, she launched a flurry of fire projectiles, each one sharper and more powerful than the last, hitting the enemy's metallic Qi.
She was versatile in almost all types of magic, but fire was her most powerful specialty. Combined with her huge mana reserves, she was almost unbeatable against enemies of the same level.
"Give up your head, you filthy son of a bitch!" Margareth cursed, continuing to fire attacks non-stop, her huge breasts bouncing with the backlash of each strike.
"Ugh..." Blackbeard spat blood, his arms burning as he tried to protect himself from the torrent of attacks, each one only increasing his inner rage.
"Enough!" He finally reached his limit. His metallic Qi exploded in a powerful shockwave, and a new type of Qi appeared on his back, strange to almost everyone there except Qingyi.
"Lineage Qi..." Qingyi whispered, slitting another pirate's throat.
Honestly, he wasn't even sweating in that battle. Every casual swing of his sword claimed a life.
Behind Blackbeard, an enormous bluish figure emerged. Large translucent tentacles clung to the stone as the shape of a giant octopus appeared.
Immediately, everyone shuddered. Even Margareth's mana was suppressed.
"As I expected, it's a bloodline... what is someone with such rare power doing as an ordinary pirate?" Qingyi asked.
Even in Immortal Heaven, bloodlines were rare.
It would be enough for that pirate to present himself to any noble family to be easily welcomed - no, great sects and noble families would fight to have him.
A real waste of talent.
Unlike the other soldiers, Qingyi felt no particular suppression from that lineage, only a reduction in the effect that his own would have if it were already active.
So he continued killing casually, his eyes focused on Margareth, ready to intervene at any moment.
This was no easy battle, not even for him.
"What kind of trick is this?" Margareth's eyes widened as she felt her mana shudder.
Even after a few years in that place, she had never seen anything like it.
"YOU WILL PAY FOR MY LITTLE BROTHER'S LIFE!" Blackbeard roared, advancing again. A steel dragon formed behind his axe as he attacked.
Margareth could only defend herself, forming more and more barriers in front of her, trying her best to push her opponent away.
But it was no use.
Her mana was severely suppressed, each of her most powerful spells being broken by Blackbeard's attack.
Originally, she was slightly stronger than the pirate, but when he activated his lineage projection, everything changed. Now he was at least five percent stronger.
It was a small difference for ordinary people, but for high-level experts, it was simply absurd.
Especially considering that Blackbeard was older and more experienced.
Margareth gritted her teeth and a thin trickle of blood ran down her plump lips. She opened her hands and pushed all her mana out, forming a powerful barrier.
The pirate's attack hit this protection with frightening force, throwing it against the cave wall.
The impact caused a huge explosion, opening a crater in the blackened stone.
Cracks spread throughout the protective bubble, but Margareth was not discouraged. On the contrary.
She pointed a single finger towards Blackbeard's exposed chest, putting all her remaining mana into that last attack.
Fortunately, the pirate was also at his wits' end, having already used up almost all the bloodline Qi he still had.
Closing her eyes, she released a thin bullet of extremely dense fire mana, which hit Blackbeard's chest, exactly over his heart.
A relieved smile came over her face when she realized that her enemy hadn't dodged or defended himself.
But the smile disappeared the moment he noticed the pirate's gaze.
"I - blergh..." He coughed up blood without stopping. "I'm not going to die like this!" He advanced towards Margareth, using what little strength he still had to try to cut her neck.
The beautiful mage closed her eyes, trying to activate some defensive artifact.
But she didn't even have enough mana left; she was completely drained.
In the end, she just relaxed.
She still had so much to research, so much to learn.
She didn't want it to end like this.
Blackbeard's face filled with delight when his axe came within centimeters of Margareth's body, but that satisfaction disappeared the next moment.
"What?" Margareth's eyes suddenly opened wide.
She felt a strong, protective embrace, her huge boobs squeezed against a firm abdomen.
"Don't worry, Lady Margareth, I'm here." Qingyi smiled as he saw her blush, his sword cutting into Blackbeard's hand and parrying his attack.
He thought it was all over, but he soon realized that the Qi behind him was going crazy.
"Fuck, is that son of a bitch trying to blow up his dantian?" Qingyi realized.
To blow up the dantian was to blow up the soul, to deny the right to go to the wheel of reincarnation.
Was Blackbeard really willing to go that far?
Gritting his teeth, he hugged Margareth tighter, using his body and a powerful ice barrier to defend her.

After thinking for a brief moment, Qingyi just shook his head and left the cultivation room.
He soon found Meilin and Margareth in the city lord's mansion.
"Have you decided?" He asked as he entered the golden-haired beauty's office.
He placed a soft kiss on each of their lips before pulling them onto his lap and sitting down on a sofa in the corner of the office.
His hands went up to the two beauties' breasts, squeezing gently.
"Mghn~~ Yes..." Meilin replied.
"Both princes make a lot of threats, but honestly, we're surrounded by supporters of the third prince.
If we declare support for the second, we'll be surrounded on all sides.
Besides, the kingdom's sects have switched their support to the second prince.
My father has problems with sects, both those here and those in the Empire of the Enlightened Sky.
I don't want to help them gain even more power."
"What about your brother?" Qingyi turned his face slightly.
He didn't consider himself a dumb person, but he also knew that in terms of intelligence, he was far from Meilin, Margareth or even other wives like Biyue and Ruxue.
So he respected their decision, although he was still a little worried about Meilin.
"There's not much you can do.
In the end, father's interests are more important.
We can deal with him when we have time."
Hearing those words, Qingyi nodded.
If that was Meilin's decision, he would help her and kill whoever stood in her way.
Turning to Margareth, he received basically the same opinion: the third prince, even at a military disadvantage, was still one of the best choices for them.
The Church of Auranys itself, which had the final say in the matter, also agreed.
The bishop provided around ten holy guards from the cathedral to accompany the force of just over a thousand men that Margareth was able to assemble.
The vast majority of this army was made up of locals who had come for work but had not yet converted.
After another week of preparation, they were finally ready to leave.
A large convoy formed around the Burning Red Pavilion.
Meilin had already placed an order for weapons and armor since the day she received that message, enough to arm an army of ten thousand men.
Meilin had already placed an order for weapons and armor since the day she received that message, enough to arm an army of ten thousand men.
The price was astronomical, but she paid no attention, preparing a perfect contract for the third prince to sign.
If they won the war, the royal government would be responsible for paying back the loan equivalent to the purchase price of the weapons plus interest of thirty-five percent a year.
If they lost, the third prince's private residences could be auctioned off to pay the full amount of the loan.
Since he would be dead if he lost, the third prince had no reason to refuse that contract.
Of course, that wasn't an absolute guarantee.
The second prince could simply seize the third prince's residences and refuse to pay, but even in this case, Meilin had a solution.
The contract would be signed with the Empire of the Illuminated Sky as the main guarantor that it would be fulfilled, something she could easily achieve with her father's help.
With a legally valid contract recognized by such a power, there was nothing the second prince could do...
"I'm a genius, hehehe..." Meilin gave a muffled giggle as she rested in Qingyi's embrace in a luxurious carriage.
"Yes, you are." The handsome young man laughed, patting Meilin on the butt before turning his face away, realizing that the carriage had started to move.
It was time for him to finally meet the third prince in person.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - The Third Prince
paragraphs: The third prince set up his camp outside the city of the Crimson Blade, ruled by one of the most powerful nobles in the Blue Sea Kingdom, his uncle and biggest supporter.
He had already amassed just over a hundred thousand soldiers, and the numbers continued to increase as he drew on the great riches received as a loan from the Five Colors Pavilion.
Unfortunately, even this money was running out. With an interest rate of up to fifty percent, the third prince was afraid to ask for more.
"Do you think that's enough, uncle?" the third prince asked the Duke of the Crimson Blade, who was leisurely sipping from a glass of wine.
They were in a large tent, sitting with other nobles around a rectangular table.
"No," the duke shook his head. "Don't expect your brother to gather less than a hundred and fifty thousand men, not now that he has the help of the great sects."
Hearing those words, the third prince gritted his teeth. His hands ran through his long golden hair as an angry expression appeared on his youthful face.
He was already over two hundred years old, but he had never had a headache this bad before.
"We need another loan, at least a few hundred million, enough to recruit others-"
"Your Highness, we have a caravan approaching on the horizon, guarded by at least a thousand soldiers!" A servant suddenly entered the tent, declaring breathlessly.
"Uh?" The prince looked confused at first. He didn't remember expecting any such group, but that soon changed as he remembered something.
A chamber of commerce that had recently exploded in growth among the nobles of the south, profiting absurd amounts in the short months since its creation.
The Burning Red Pavilion.
The prince stood up, walked outside and then flew into the air, watching the caravan on the horizon.
Those were indeed the flags of the Burning Red Pavilion, but not only that.
There were also strange banners that he had never seen in his life, but which he briefly recognized from some documents he had once seen his father sign.
They were the people of the lands beyond the Celestial Blue Sea, followers of a strange goddess.
The prince landed in front of the camp that stretched for miles, waiting patiently until a carriage pulled up in front of him.
After a brief moment, the doors of that carriage opened, displaying two incomparable beauties, but the third prince's eyes barely passed through them.
They were focused on the man who appeared just behind them, exuding a strangely familiar aura.
The prince watched Qingyi for a moment longer before something finally dawned on him.
He was the one who had killed the young master of the Wang family, Wang Haoran.
Sensing Qingyi's cultivation, the third prince couldn't help but shudder.
Just five months ago, that young man was capable of killing cultivators of the Enlightened Soul realm while only being at the Ascension realm.
But now, his cultivation had already exploded to the point of reaching the Flowing Meridian realm.
In his entire life, he had never seen such rapid growth, comparable even to the geniuses of the Enlightened Sky Empire.
"Is there a problem, Your Highness?" Meilin asked respectfully, finally snapping the third prince out of his stupor.
"Not at all, young miss Meilin. In fact, it's a pleasure to see you and Lady..." He turned his face to the other beauty.
"Margareth," she replied. "This is our husband, Long Qingyi."
"Oh, so it's young master Long Qingyi." The third prince smiled, offering his hand to Qingyi.
"Please don't be so respectful to this humble, Your Highness," Qingyi said, casting an approving glance at the third prince as he shook his hand.
From the moment they arrived, the third prince focused only on him, barely paying attention to his women.
This look was more like that of a warrior studying the power of another than anything else.
Qingyi couldn't deny that he was pleased with this treatment. It was rare to find men who didn't stare too much at their wives.
"Right, Miss Meilin, Lady Margareth, what do you say we discuss the terms of your support for our cause?"
They both opened their mouths to answer the third prince, but before they could even speak, a crash echoed on the horizon, drawing everyone's attention.
Meilin was hit hardest, gritting her teeth.
In the sky, she saw a luxurious flying ship, bigger, faster and more powerful than anything even entire years of the Blue Sea Kingdom's budget could buy.
It was a true colossus of luxury, rare even among the elites of the Enlightened Sky Empire.
It was a personal gift she received from her father when she turned eighteen. It was stuck in the hangars of the Five Colors Pavilion, theoretically undergoing repairs.
Being a gift from her father, she never really bothered to go after it.
Firstly because she was sure that the repairs had stopped, and secondly because she was sure that Tianshi wouldn't be crazy enough to confiscate a personal gift she had received from the Gold King.
But as it turned out, she was very wrong.
With an irritated grunt, she waved her hands and a small talisman appeared in her fingers.
Without hesitating, she pointed it towards the ship and pressed a small button.
The next moment, she saw the eyes of everyone there go wide as the powerful engines sustained by a complex alloy of spiritual arrays shut down.
In a single moment, the colossus went down, flipping on its side.
At the last second, she pressed the button again and the engines restarted, just in time for a landing that was violent, but insufficient to cause damage to the flying ship.
"Damn it, you crazy bitch, what do you think you're doing?" A hate-filled roar echoed as the ship's door opened, but Meilin didn't care.
She decided to fight for herself and solve the problem on her own when her position was taken, and even when her bank accounts were cleaned out.
But that flying ship was a gift from her father, a real gift that he gave her as a birthday present.
She would make Tianshi regret putting his dirty hands where they didn't belong!

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - Consequences
paragraphs: A bang echoed as Jin Tianshi left the flying ship, his clothes soaked with wine and dirty with food scraps. His face was full of hatred.
It seems he was having a pleasant meal when Meilin turned off the flying ship's engines.
"How dare you do this to me? I'm the leader of the Five Colors Pavilion branch in this damned kingdom!" Tianshi declared, one hand on his sword.
"You're more like a damned bandit, stealing the birthday present I got from Dad! Do I need to tell you the consequences of doing something like that?"
Meilin didn't back down either, not even when the true immortal who always accompanied Tianshi appeared.
"Your..." Tianshi gritted his teeth hard enough for his gums to bleed, his sword sliding out of its sheath.
"Bitch! I'll show you who'll suffer the consequences here!"
The True Immortal even thought about stopping him, but after a brief moment, he just shook his head, looking at Qingyi.
That wouldn't be necessary and honestly, Tianshi needed to suffer some consequences for his actions.
"Get out of the way insect!" Tianshi shouted, not seeming to recognize Qingyi.
"ah... looks like shitting your pants last time wasn't shameful enough for you, huh?" Qingyi flashed a big smile, feeling Tianshi's Qi explode.
Tianshi was stronger than before, but unfortunately for him, Qingyi was also much stronger than before.
The handsome young man even thought about drawing his sword, but in the end, he decided to use his bare hands, surrounding them with black scales as he grabbed Tianshi's sword.

"You... I order you to-" before Tianshi was even able to finish his sentence, he was interrupted by a powerful kick from Qingyi, straight into his face, leaving a perfect reddish mark from his boots on the pale skin of the arrogant son of the gold king.
"ah..." The True Immortal sighed, stepping to the side and catching Tianshi before he hit the flying ship.
Fortunately, this time Tianshi hadn't dirtied his pants, but seeing him drooling with a broken nose and a clouded conscience made the immortal think that this defeat had been even more shameful.

"I beg your pardon for that, young Miss Meilin, I reminded him that your flying ship was a personal gift from the Gold King and that, even as branch leader, he shouldn't touch it." The True Immortal bowed respectfully.
Honestly, he cursed his fate a little.
Who had he offended in his past life to deserve such a brat? The money he received from Tianshi was good, but he already earned well as a direct servant of the branch.
He regretted having taken part in that plan to get rid of Meilin.
'How could a man like the Gold King have a son like that?' The immortal wondered.
Tianshi was arrogant, foolish, even incapable of realizing how little power he truly had.
After a short moment, Tianshi's eyes opened slightly. He was confused at first, but this confusion soon turned to anger as he turned away from the real immortal.

"You bastard... you know who I am, I'm the son of the gold king, don't think you're going to get away with this just because you're my sister's little boyfriend!" Tianshi roared, turning to the immortal and pointing at Qingyi.
"I order you to kill him right now, I'm the branch leader, you should obey me and serve, I have the power-"
The moment those last words escaped Tianshi's lips, Meilin burst into laughter.
"Father has the power, you're nothing but a pig who used a disgusting tactic to take my position, you're lucky that husband hasn't torn you apart yet!"
She shouted, not even a little afraid to escalate the situation.
Tianshi was about to reply when the third prince finally decided to intervene.
"I beg your pardon, young master Tianshi, young miss Meilin, but I believe we have more important things to deal with and above all, a war to win.
Can you forget your personal disagreements for the sake of our cause?"
"Yes, that would be best." The True Immortal behind Tianshi spoke, casting a deadly glance at the arrogant young master.
After a brief moment of internal struggle, Tianshi clenched his fists, lowering his head.
'It won't stay that way...' He repeated internally, cursing Qingyi and Meilin in his mind as he turned, entering the camp of the third prince's army.
"Empty my flying ship, everyone must leave." Meilin ordered the True Immortal before turning back to Qingyi.
The handsome young man was smiling at her next to Margareth, the golden-haired beauty clinging tightly to his arm, pulling him into her cleavage, enveloping his forearm with her huge, soft tits.
"I'm sorry husband, I didn't mean to cause trouble." Meilin said softly, but Qingyi just shook his head.
"You did the right thing," he said, grabbing her slim, delicate waist, staying like that for another moment before separating.
They were about to meet with much of the kingdom's high nobility and they didn't want any nobles with bruised egos to find their proximity on such an occasion disrespectful.
" Very well." The prince clapped his hands and a group of servants served wine to everyone there, whose eyes were focused on the newcomers.
They obviously knew Jin Meilin well, she was famous both for her recent affair with a young man called Qingyi, her talent for business and, of course, her position as the daughter of the gold king.

"Miss Meilin, thank you for coming, the support of the Burning Red Pavilion is essential to our effort to have a fair and dignified leader on the royal throne, not that man-shaped pile of muscles that is the second prince."
One of the nobles spoke, receiving a respectful smile from Meilin, who sat next to Margareth on the only two free chairs there.
Qingyi, a commoner who, in that nobleman's eyes, had only his beauty and talent as a positive point, had to stand, but he honestly preferred it that way.
If anyone messed up, he could act and protect his wives much more easily.
"Well, can we start the meeting?" The third prince stood up. "Miss Meilin, what are the terms of your help to our cause?"

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - The First Princess
paragraphs: Meilin opened her mouth to speak, but a voice interrupted her, causing the complexion of her beautiful face to darken with irritation.
Obviously, it was Jin Tianshi.
"The five-colour pavilion will not support the third prince if he accepts money from a rival organization."
"Young master Tianshi, are you talking about breaking the contract you made with us?" The third prince turned his face, everyone there watching Tianshi as if he were the biggest idiot in the world.
He was the leader of a branch that belonged to the gold king, the face of the five-colored pavilion.
Every contract he signed was a contract signed by the Gold King, who gave his own image as a guarantee of fulfillment.
Did that idiot really want to tarnish his own father's image because of a personal tantrum with his sister?
"Young master, please..." The True Immortal leaned over, grabbing Tianshi's shoulder.
Suddenly, the two seemed to enter into a violent exchange of sound transmissions, which only ended when Tianshi crossed his arms, cringing angrily.
Why on earth did no one there respect his decisions? He wasn't a man-child!
Ignoring Tianshi, Meilin simply took out the contract, handing it to the third prince, who read it carefully before sighing.
The amount was... acceptable and the interest rates, although high, were quite lenient compared to what he had received from Tianshi.
In the end, it was an extremely high-risk loan, even with all the guarantees.
"Lady Margareth, what are your demands?" He focused his gaze on the other beauty.
"The church wants a guarantee that the territories ceded to it will be respected and also permission to build a cathedral in the royal capital," Margareth said.
Her demands seemed few, but they were big victories for the church, especially the last one.
They were giving up less than a thousand soldiers and, in return, they could spread their faith even further.
Margareth even wanted to ask for monetary compensation at the end of the war, but she was only a representative or, rather, the manager of a church territory.
The final word on such an important matter was in the hands of the bishop of Eagle Peak Valley.
"Hm..." The third prince thought for a brief moment before nodding. "Very well, I agree to these terms."
"Any questions?" He raised his head to the nobles present.
None of them had anything against this contract, many having an extremely positive view of young Miss Meilin.
Smiling, the third prince signed the documents, making the agreements official.
After that, long strategic conversations ensued, discussions about what to do next, how to secure food for the armies and, above all, how to defeat the second prince.
This was a conversation that Qingyi was totally uninterested in, even though he was listening attentively.
He honestly just wanted some time to fuck his women, was that too much to ask?
After a few more hours, such conversations finally ceased and the third prince stood up.
"Some here may already know about my sister's marriage to young master Tianshi. I know she doesn't show herself much, but today is the day we finally reveal her to the world."
All the men there suddenly raised their heads.
The first princess, the king's only daughter. She lived in isolation and, even at banquets, didn't appear in public.
The few who ever met her in private never talked about her appearance, while those who didn't know her could only imagine.
Even Tianshi, her current spouse, had never met her in person.

Rumors naturally ran wild, speaking of an incomparable beauty, the kind that, if shown to the world, could easily attract the attention of the powerful experts of the Empire of the Enlightened Sky, bringing doom to the kingdom.
Even Qingyi raised his face. Finally, something interesting was happening.

As far as he knew, that princess was in a political marriage with Wang Haoran, and he still remembered the promise he made to the arrogant young master: to find his future wife and make her the happiest woman in the world.
Apparently, this day was coming.
[Don't get so excited, you shameless womanizer...] Meilin giggled, sending a sound transmission to Qingyi.
She was the only one there who had ever met the princess in person.
Qingyi was a little confused at first. What did Meilin mean by that?
After a short moment, the answer to his doubts finally arrived, and his extremely sensitive senses picked up the sound of heavy footsteps on the horizon.
Strangely, he seemed to be the only one there to notice. Everyone else's eyes were filled with anxiety, which turned to shock the moment a figure entered the tent.
She was... unique.
Her waist was a little wider than her shoulders, her hips tapering down to slim, delicate legs that strangely matched her barrel-shaped torso.
Her face was large and round, her neck hidden by large pillows of fat.
At that moment, observing the look of sheer terror in Tianshi's eyes and the shock on the faces of the nobles, Qingyi understood.
The few who met the first princess didn't talk about her appearance simply because she was so ugly that talking about such a thing was simply disrespectful.
Qingyi glanced briefly at the first princess's information screen before shaking his head.
Even her traits were horrible.
Suddenly, he didn't even want to kill Tianshi anymore - no, he regretted killing Haoran.
Marrying something like that was worse than death. How could someone be so ugly in a world where experts could shape their bodies so freely?
'I'm sorry, young master Wang... I'll have to break this promise...' Qingyi repeated in his mind.
" Heavens... no..." Tianshi muttered, his face no longer filled with arrogance or pride.
"Oh... so this is my future hubby? He's so handsome!" The first princess flashed a big smile, the ground shaking slightly as she ran towards Tianshi, pulling him into a strong, suffocating embrace.
Both Meilin and Qingyi had to fight hard to hold back their laughter.
Apparently, Tianshi's karma had arrived much sooner than expected.

"Any questions?" He raised his head to the nobles present.

Smiling, the third prince signed the documents, making the agreements official.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - Karma is truly a bitch.
paragraphs: After leaving Meilin's flying ship, Qingyi put it into the world of the mind and accompanied them into the camp.
A lot had happened in the two weeks since they arrived there.

Firstly, a large influx of soldiers hired by the third prince with the loan he received from Meilin, as well as another seventy thousand cultivators of the Transcendence Realm or above joining the army.
Secondly, and the part that made Qingyi happiest: the attempts by Jin Tianshi, Jin Meilin's brother, to cancel the wedding.

Unfortunately for him, the wedding was on the loan contract he gave to the third prince, who had already acted quickly by sending a letter to the Empire of the Enlightened Sky, asking for the Golden King's approval.
When the reply came, all of Tianshi's plans fell apart. His father had agreed to the wedding, which was to take place right after the civil war.

Not that it mattered much. The first princess was more powerful than Tianshi and, from the rumors Qingyi had heard, she had already dragged him to her private residence in Crimson Blade City, forcing him to consummate the marriage.
'Karma is truly a bitch...' Qingyi sighed, shaking his head.
He was about to say something to Meilin when a voice interrupted him. A soldier in heavy scale armor approached.
"Young master Qingyi, the third prince is requesting your presence at a private audience in his personal palace in the city." The soldier bowed respectfully.
"Uh? What is His Highness's wish with my husband?" Meilin turned her face uncomfortably, but the guard only shook his head in response.
"I'm not sure, he just told me it has something to do with the Wang family."
Qingyi was disinterested at first, but his interest was piqued when he heard that it had something to do with the Wang family.
"All right, I'll accompany you." Qingyi said, placing soft kisses on the lips of his two wives before following the soldier.
They soon entered the great walls, passing through the wide main street of the city and arriving at the noble zone, inhabited by wealthy merchants.
The palace was one of the many residences of the third prince throughout the kingdom, smaller only than the palace of the city lord.
Passing the servants who greeted them respectfully, Qingyi was led to the private training arena of the third prince, who was swinging his sword lazily.
Announcing his presence, the guard bowed before withdrawing, leaving Qingyi alone with the third prince.
"Oh... you're here..." The third prince turned his face, flashing a big smile at Qingyi.
"Greetings, Your Highness, what do you wish of me?" Qingyi asked.
The third prince looked thoughtful, scratching his chin before smiling. "You killed Wang Haoran. His father is quite a famous hero in the kingdom, you know. He'll be here soon."
"Ah... it's truly impossible to hide anything from the third prince. How did you find out about me?" Qingyi said, deciding that there was no point in denying it.
The third prince already seemed completely sure of what he was saying.

"Your residual Qi. Honestly, it wasn't too difficult to identify you." The third prince spoke, swinging his sword a few more times. "I'm not here to judge you. Wang Haoran was a disgusting little fellow who didn't deserve much respect. In reality, you've helped me a lot."
"So, what does Your Highness want with me?" Qingyi asked.
"I want to sense your power, just a friendly fight, if you're not afraid to fight me." The third prince pointed his sword towards Qingyi, who smiled.
He had expected threats or complaints, but fortunately, it was nothing of the sort. On the contrary, it was a very good thing for Qingyi.
Even if they weren't going to fight at full strength, he still wanted to know what his limits were against a false immortal.
"Please guide this junior, Your Highness." The heaven-defying thunder sword slid out of its beautiful sheath with a sharp hiss.
They both stared at each other for a brief moment before advancing; they didn't use Qi or even any techniques, just pure physical strength.
The moment their blades met, the arena shook, a shockwave rising from the impact, causing their clothes to flutter.
They stared at each other for a brief moment, their eyes full of ferocity as their muscles burned with effort.
The third prince couldn't help but widen his eyes as his feet slid gently, forcing him to grit his teeth.

He knew that Qingyi had a powerful bloodline, but being able to push him back was something the third prince simply hadn't expected, especially when Qingyi hadn't even used his bloodline projection yet.
Just... how powerful was that young man's body?
Preparing himself, the third prince retreated, before attacking again, this time using some of his Qi.
When they started using their Qi and some basic techniques, the third prince was able to gain a small advantage, but he still wasn't satisfied.
Activating his movement technique, his body disappeared in a gust of air at the same time as Qingyi's own body also disappeared, turning into a flash of lightning.

The air in the room calmed down, but this calm only lasted for a single second before an explosion rang out, followed by ten metallic bangs. The floor of the arena was completely torn up by the power of the attacks, with two panting figures appearing on either side of the arena.
"Ah... I'm truly not enough to deal with the third prince yet," Qingyi said, bowing respectfully.
The third prince laughed. "I'm the one who's failing by having to use so much of my power against a junior. I really need to focus more on my training."
Exchanging a few more blows, Qingyi finally left, relatively excited.
The third prince had not yet used his full strength and was only at the initial stage of the false immortal realm, but Qingyi still came out of that fight with one certainty.
If he used his maximum power and his lineage, his power was equal to that of a false immortal.
How could he not be excited about that? His bloodline was getting exponentially stronger with each advance.
Fortunately, they would soon start marching and during the war, he would have the opportunity to use all his power.
