chapters.title: Chapter 328 - Trust your husband
paragraphs: Two weeks after Qingyi, Margareth and Meilin arrived at the third prince's camp, one of the many escorts from the north brought alarming news: the second prince's armies were marching south.
Naturally, this news caused chaos among the third prince's supporters, who quickly gathered in the large command tent in the military camp.
"Shall we begin?" The third prince stood up, soon realizing that someone was missing.
Jin Tianshi, leader of the kingdom's branch of the Five Colors Pavilion.
Fortunately, this absence didn't last long, and soon a hunched figure entered the room, limping slightly.
His eyes were empty, the legs of his bed were broken and his hips ached, the bones about to crack.
Apparently, he hadn't had a very restful night's sleep.
Watching him in that state, Qingyi almost felt sorry for him. But in the end, that almost pity didn't outweigh the urge to laugh.
Everyone found the love they deserved and, fortunately, Tianshi had found his.
Shaking his head, the third prince focused his gaze on a minor nobleman, one of those responsible for the intelligence coming from the North.
Clearing his throat, the nobleman stood up.
"Your Highness, the second prince seems to be in despair, especially after being denied access to the royal coffers.
He has been looting and burning villages, even besieging towns in search of payment, no different from common criminals.
His men have been given free rein to kill, rape and steal. We need to stop him as soon as possible."
"I'm already aware of that. I want to know about the new reports," the third prince nodded, sighing.
The northern region had always been the most resistant to royal rule, and with the actions of the second prince's army, the resistance was likely to be even greater.
What was his brother's idea? To rule over ashes? Couldn't he have gotten loans from the big sects?
They weren't as rich as the Five Colors Pavilion and the Burning Red Pavilion, but they still represented considerable resources.
"Naturally, Your Highness." The nobleman bowed, picking up some documents from his desk, separating the new reports from the old ones.
"The second prince was seen marching with his army of one hundred and fifty thousand soldiers, passing through the northwest valley and heading towards the royal plains.
They are ignoring all the allied strongholds and just heading straight towards us, sacking villages along the way as a way of gathering resources to continue their march."
"Hmm..." The third prince scratched his chin as he thought.
It was obvious what his brother wanted to do: win that war in a single battle, avoiding getting into a long war of attrition in which the third prince would have total advantage.
"Uncle, what do you think?" The third prince asked the Duke of the Crimson Blade, sitting next to him.
"We should march out and meet him in the field, even if we lose our greatest advantage," the duke said, rising from his chair.
"If we allow him to continue like this, even you will suffer damage to your reputation, portrayed as a man who abandons his subjects and flees while they are slaughtered.
We have to stop the second prince as soon as possible."
The third prince listened to those words carefully before nodding. Yes, his uncle was right, he knew that.

paragraphs: One hundred and seventy thousand marching cultivators were truly a sight that could not be ignored, their ranks stretching for countless kilometers.
This march lasted about two weeks, crossing a distance of more than a thousand kilometers until they finally reached the royal plains, stopping in a huge clearing surrounded by a dense forest.
They were still to march for a few more kilometers until they reached the fort where they would rest and prepare to go after the second prince, but they were forced to stop right there.
Looking across the clearing, the third prince saw banners he knew well. They were his brother's.
Turning to one of his generals, he ordered the troops to organize themselves, watching his brother's armies appear on the horizon.
Qingyi fortunately managed to keep up with Margareth, with Meilin in Ruxue's mind world.
They were now on the right flank of the huge army, exactly on the front line.
Thinking for a brief moment, Qingyi opened the system store, bought a small necklace and wrapped it around Margareth's neck.
"Is that?..." Margareth was a little confused at first, trying to study the object.
It was beautiful, a vibrant blue that matched her eyes.
"It's a defensive artifact, it will teleport you to the world of the mind if you're in danger."
"Oh... thank you husband!" Margareth's eyes sparkled as she kissed Qingyi, her face slightly blushing.
Whatever it was for, she had liked the gift.
She turned to the soldiers behind her, the ones she had brought from the Eagle Peak Valley.
"Ready your weapons, show those sons of bitches death!" She shouted, answered by howls in unison from all her soldiers.
Margareth smiled at the sight, standing beside Qingyi as they watched the second prince's army organize itself.

Soon, the entire clearing was filled with nothing but soldiers, the lines stretching as far as the forest on the horizon, where small skirmishes and exchanges of projectiles already seemed to have begun.
The powerful Qi's of the fake immortals were already colliding as they flew into the sky, ready to start their own battle, on a completely different level to the one that would take place just below.
"Surrender brother, I will forgive your crimes against our people!" The third prince spoke, floating about a hundred meters off the ground, exactly in front of the second prince.
"I don't need your forgiveness brother, just your head!" The second prince roared, drawing his huge sword and attacking.
The moment this attack landed on the third prince's blade, the two armies advanced, the captains and generals struggling to hold formation as the lines finally met.
The right flank was one of the first to make contact.
Margareth's figure floated slightly above the ground, her hands pointing towards the enemy soldiers as hundreds of small fireballs appeared around her.

After a brief moment of channeling mana, she launched them, hitting the enemy front lines with powerful explosions, immediately killing dozens of soldiers and breaking the formation of part of the vanguard.
Qingyi and the foot soldiers didn't miss this opportunity, tearing through the weakened lines, slashing and killing without stopping.
After the first few hundred deaths, the vanguard in that part finally managed to stabilize, turning into a long battle of attrition where no side could break through the other.
Qingyi obviously had no difficulty with this.
In fact, he was even a little disappointed as he cut non-stop, the number of corpses at his feet already reaching dozens.
Apart from the fake immortals in the skies, he truly had no enemy to match.
He even thought about using his maximum power to massacre the enemy lines more quickly, but in the end he held back.
The place was too crowded. If he didn't control his power, he would end up killing the allied forces too.
Qingyi was about to leap into the sky, trying to reach the enemy rear line, where he would have more freedom.
But between the screams of pain, the explosions of powerful techniques exchanged between the experts and the sound of metal hitting metal, he noticed something, turning his face towards Margareth.
The necklace he had given her had just activated, pulling her into the world of the mind.
Qingyi was confused at first, but his eyes soon fluttered and he covered his body with black scales.
The next moment, a powerful explosion engulfed his body, sending him flying like a cannonball, killing hundreds of the soldiers around him.
"Ugh... Fuck!" Qingyi barely had time to realize who was attacking him before he was hit again, sent hurtling towards the forest.
His body tore through trees and even soldiers fighting in the area, drenching his black scales in blood.
When he barely managed to straighten his posture, he was hit again, thrown even harder than before.
Each attempt to recover had the same result until, finally, he found himself so far from the battlefield that he could barely hear its noise.
"Ah... shit..." He clutched his chest, feeling a few broken ribs as he lifted his face.
"You killed my son." A voice hoarse with hatred echoed and Qingyi saw a figure descending from the sky, a middle-aged man with a noble face and elegant clothes, watching him coldly.
"Oh... hahaha" Qingyi laughed, cracking his sore back.
"So it's little cuckold Jiantian... you came here to beg me for your granddaddy to take care of your wife? She's a bit old for me, but I can make this sacrifice."
"Don't you dare despise me! I'm the patriarch of the Wang family!" Jiantian roared, his cultivation of the peak of the False Immortal realm falling on Qingyi, who just shook his head.
Little by little, a black Qi emerged from his back, a bestial figure forming.
This time, Qingyi didn't hold back his bloodline projection, releasing it with all his might. The enormous dragon reached over two hundred meters, its roar causing the earth to shake for kilometers.
"I'm not despising you," Qingyi said curtly.
"I'm even using all my power to fight you, how could I despise you? I was just curious, you know. I know a lot of old men like you have this strange taste."
"You..." Jiantian gritted his teeth, his eyes filled with rage.

His cultivation was being partially suppressed by Qingyi's lineage projection and every drop of his being was screaming at that huge purple-eyed beast, but the hatred he felt in his heart overrode everything.
"You will pay for what you did to my Haoran!"

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - Little cuckold Jiantian
paragraphs: Qingyi raised his blade, protecting himself from Jiantian's attack. His feet sank into the ground as an explosion of metallic sparks filled the air.
He gritted his teeth and used the first form of the Tempest Monarch's sword art, pushing Jiantian back with a thunderous, powerful thrust.
Taking a moment to himself, Qingyi inhaled deeply.
Even being suppressed, the power of a cultivator at the peak of the false immortal was still frightening, but fortunately, it wasn't enough.
With a gentle smile, Qingyi attacked again. His body split into afterimages as his blade flew towards Jiantian's neck.
The Wang family patriarch barely managed to dodge, a thin trickle of blood running down his neck.
"What's the matter, little cuckold Wang Jiantian? Don't you want to face your grandpa here directly?" teased Qingyi, bursting into laughter.
"Don't you dare call me that even once more!" roared Patriarch Wang, charging towards Qingyi.
"Or what?" The provocation in Qingyi's voice died away abruptly, drowned out by the clang of blades meeting and the roar of the shockwave that spread through the forest.
The soft ground beneath their feet sank into a crater, with cracks spreading for dozens of meters.
Suddenly, Jiantian shuddered. The suppression he felt from Qingyi's bloodline grew even stronger, accompanied by an intense murderous intent.
"Tell me, little cuckold Jiantian, what are you going to do? Piss your pants like your son did before he died?"
Qingyi asked again, putting more strength into his grip and sending Jiantian away.
He watched Jiantian's face contort in fury, his Qi exploding with full force around his body, licks of flame taking over everything.
"You... fucking son of a bitch!" roared Jiantian, readying his sword, a hurricane of flames surrounding the blade.
"You'll pay for this with a thousand - no, TEN THOUSAND DEATHS! YOUR SOUL WILL NEVER REST!
Despite the threats, Qingyi hardly cared. In fact, he was happy.
The less self-control Jiantian had over his own Qi, the easier his fight would be.
He retracted his heaven-defying thunder sword. Exactly thirty-two ethereal, thunderous blades surrounded his body, their powerful lightning Qi making the surrounding air boil.
In that brief moment, their eyes met and they both attacked.
From Jiantian's sword, a thread of flame emerged, slashing towards Qingyi, offering no resistance to the thirty-two thundering blades.

Qingyi surrounded his body with a wall of ice, which held off the attack for a brief moment before giving way, forcing him to hold back the blow with only the black dragon's scales, driving his sword into the ground.
Jiantian's face was filled with ecstasy as he watched Qingyi being engulfed in flames, narrowly dodging the many swords that flew towards him.
He barely noticed when they suddenly stopped flying, the ethereal metal that made them up swelling before exploding into balls of lightning, swallowing everything within dozens of meters.
When the explosions caused by both attacks stopped, they revealed two figures.
Qingyi was almost intact, except for a few burns on the black dragon scales.
Jiantian, on the other hand, was on his knees, his clothes torn, his hair reduced to burnt ends and his eyes filled with deep shock.
He was a false immortal, destined to become a true immortal and live for at least fifty thousand years.
How could he not get rid of that little bug with ease? How could he be suffering against Qingyi?
He wouldn't just die, would he? Without even avenging his son's death?
Such a thought immediately filled Jiantian with horror, more horror than even that huge dragon caused him.
His beloved Haoran... he had to avenge him, no matter what.
Wang Jiantian's Qi changed once again, this time powerful enough to make Qingyi take a step backwards, a pillar of flame rising up to the heavens.
It only took Qingyi a single moment to realize what was happening, his heart sinking slightly.
That was a forced breakthrough, and powerful enough that the residual Qi alone was capable of tearing his skin beneath the black dragon's scales.
"Brat... today you die," Jiantian's voice echoed. His body floated a few centimeters off the ground, seized by an absurd amount of power, his eyes replaced by nothing but glowing flaming orbs.
The dragon on Qingyi's back roared at Jiantian, who shuddered but didn't lower his head.
Even with his Qi being suppressed, he was sure that this battle was won.
He didn't know if he would survive that advance, but it didn't matter.
He already had the power of a true immortal, even if his body and soul exploded. All he had to do was kill Qingyi.
"Ah... hahaha." A bitter laugh escaped Qingyi's lips.
The heaven-defying thunder sword was surrounded by a new kind of power: gray flames, the heat of which made the flames of Jiantian's advance look like fake fire in children's toys.
"It's been a long time since I've had a battle this difficult... Don't let me down," said Qingyi, spitting a gout of blood onto the ground.
At that moment, they both attacked. Jiantian used his family's most powerful technique, his sword turning into a flash of light, while Qingyi used no technique at all.
The moment these blades met, the world split between the gray flames of Qingyi and the blazing flames of Jiantian, whose face immediately filled with terror.
He was pushing everything towards Qingyi, all the Qi generated by that forced breakthrough, all the energy from the heavens that entered his body.
Yet nothing was enough - no, quite the opposite, his Qi seemed to be being devoured by those flames, like dry leaves used to put out a fire.

It didn't take more than a moment for Jiantian to notice the flames climbing up the handle of his blade and spreading to his hand, reducing flesh to bone. Intense pain ripped a muffled scream from his throat.
His Qi ceased and the melted tip of his blade fell to the ground, the heaven-defying thunder sword plunging into his chest.
"So this is how I die... but I'm not going alone!" Jiantian pointed his remaining hand towards Qingyi, finally using his law.

And then there was a third type of law, laws that were beyond the control of the heavens.
Qingyi's primordial chaos flames were part of this third type, something that could overcome a heavenly tribulation on its own.
The moment Qingyi felt the law of Jiantian, he understood: that law was part of the third type.
The space around him distorted violently and the heaven-defying thunder sword was almost knocked out of his hands, forcing him to hold on to it with all his might.
Jiantian's law was linked to the control of space and he was at that very moment trying to use this power to tear Qingyi's body apart, creating horrible spatial distortions.
Qingyi gritted his teeth. His body was sucked into a place of absolute blackness, similar to when he used teleportation arrays, but much more unstable.
Even the black dragon's scales were damaged and if it hadn't been for its powerful body, he was sure it would have been torn in half by now.
Trying to calm his breathing, Qingyi surrounded his body with draconic Qi. The black dragon's projection seemed to engulf him completely, protecting him from most of the spatial instabilities.
When the space around him finally calmed down, Qingyi had already used up all of his Qi.
His body was covered in horrible scars, the scales of the black dragon torn from his skin, leaving large chunks of him in living flesh.
His eyes closed for a brief moment as he finally left that fissure in space, appearing above a verdant forest.
Qingyi then plummeted towards the green abyss.
He hit the treetops, breaking a few branches and falling backwards onto the soft ground, surrounded by low, soft grass.
When he opened his eyes again, he saw Isabel's figure appear beside him. Her eyes were watering as she pressed her hands against Qingyi's chest.
Qingxue, Ruyan and Margareth appeared soon after, all with their beautiful faces full of concern as they surrounded Qingyi and Isabel.
"Please, husband... Don't leave us..." Isabel whimpered, drawing a smile from Qingyi.
"It's all right, silly girl. Do you really think your husband is going to die from such superficial injuries? Hahaha." He gave a pained chuckle.
His Qi was depleted and many of his internal organs had been ruptured, but in the end, Qingyi still had the body of a dragon.
His heart was beating and his Dantian was intact, despite being exhausted. This alone guaranteed him far more vitality than many cultivators of the same level would have.
Even so, Isabel's healing mana helped him a lot, flowing through his body, healing his muscles and internal organs, stopping the bleeding much more easily than his natural healing would.
Despite his words, Isabel didn't calm down one bit, pouring out the most powerful healing spells she knew in succession.
Even Margareth knelt down beside him, pulling his head into her lap and using the few but effective healing spells she knew.
"You shameless womanizer, don't you dare get into these battles again! What do you think will become of poor Meilin's heart? And your other wives?" Margareth said.
Despite the façade of a strong woman, her lips were trembling, as were those of the demonic beauty and the silver-haired beauty.
"You know I'm never not going to run of a fight like this, right?" He smiled, finally finding the strength to stand up.
The blood had been wiped from his body. His tattered clothes fell to the ground and were quickly replaced by a new set of pure white robes.
Even the dirt and blood on his body was quickly removed by one of Margareth's spells.
"Husband... you're still not completely healed..." Isabel said, but Qingyi just shook his head in response.
"Don't worry, it's enough." Qingyi placed a long kiss on Isabel's lips before turning to Margareth and doing the same.
After that, he took Ruyan and Qingxue in his arms, slapping their shapely asses vigorously.
Qingxue gave a high-pitched, embarrassed squeal as Ruyan's eyes glared at her husband.
"Nghnn~~ did hubby's injuries awaken your big dragon? Fufufu~~ My little demon pussy missed you..." Ruyan's beautiful red eyes narrowed into a seductive expression as she rubbed up against Qingyi.
"He's wide awake..." Qingyi smiled, squeezing her buttocks for a brief moment before sighing.
"But husband can't take care of that tight little pussy right now... I promise to make it up to you later." He spoke, his voice gaining a little seriousness as he waved his hand.
"Go back to the world of the mind."
"But husband... your injuries..." Isabel complained, but seeing Qingyi's serious look, she lowered her head.
Qingyi wouldn't have such a serious expression for just anything.
The moment he found himself alone, Qingyi activated his draconic eyes, studying his surroundings.
He honestly had no idea where he was, apart from the fact that they were still on the Golden Plains Continent, in a place whose Qi density was much higher than the Qi density in the Blue Sea Realm.
As such, he could only assume that they were in one of the most central locations on the continent, perhaps close to the Empire of the Illuminated Sky.
The forest looked ordinary and untouched, dense and verdant, but there was something strange about it.
A sweet smell invaded their nostrils. A strange smoke wafted through the air, accompanied by a type of Qi he had never come into contact with in his entire life.
Suddenly, Qingyi raised his hands, grabbing an arrow out of the air. The impact was powerful enough to make his clothes flutter and his feet tear the ground.
That was coming from a powerful enemy and it certainly wasn't good news for him.
His Qi reserves were far from recovered and his body was still badly injured.
"Come out and face me!" He spoke, readying the heaven-defying thunder sword.
The next moment, figures appeared on the horizon, causing deep shock in Qingyi as he realized two things that all those people had.
Feline ears and tails.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - Catfolk
paragraphs: Slowly, the figures watching Qingyi revealed themselves.
They were just like ordinary humans, the only real difference being the presence of sharp claws, a pair of feline ears and a fluffy tail, as well as eyes not different from those of an ordinary cat.
They wore clothes made from different types of animal skins and held spears, bows and throwing knives.
"They look like catfolk, they come from the same land as Xueyao's people."
Ruxue's voice echoed in Qingyi's mind, who nodded, still not letting his guard down.
There were around twenty opponents. Most of them were in the False Immortal realm, with only one whose cultivation was so deep that Qingyi could barely sense him.
Strangely, he wasn't among the group that surrounded Qingyi, just watching silently from afar.
His eyes showed surprise when he saw Qingyi's gaze focused on him.
"This one looks strong..."
"Would he be good prey for the great hunt?"
"I don't know... he looks like a human, isn't the great hunt only for beasts?"
Murmurs echoed among the cat people surrounding Qingyi.
They were all young boys, the eldest appearing to be no more than seventeen, despite his profound cultivation.
"Brats..." Qingyi lost his temper when he heard those words, taking a Qi recovery pill while calling on the little bit of bloodline Qi that had already recovered.
"One more word, and you'll be the prey!" He roared.
The figure of an enormous dragon appeared on his back, its bestial roar echoing for miles, shaking the forest.
The young men backed away in fright and the expert watching the scene shook his head, sighing before leaping towards them, landing in front of Qingyi.
He was a middle-aged man in the True Immortal realm, clearly at the limit of his talent, unlike those young cat men.
"Young dragon, I beg your pardon for the disrespect of the younger ones, but I ask you to control your aura. After all, you're on our tribe's territory."
The expert spoke, his feline eyes scanning Qingyi curiously as his tail moved gently across his back.
The handsome young man hesitated for a brief moment before retracting his bloodline Qi. This was no time for that kind of fight, not in his current state.
Besides, unlike the young men, that man didn't seem to have any hostile intent towards Qingyi, treating him with a strange respect.
"Junior Long Qingyi salutes senior," Qingyi clenched his fists, but didn't bow. "May I ask what you mean by 'young dragon'? I am a human."
"A human?" The True Immortal sniffed the air, his feline ears rising slightly before he shook his head.
"You don't smell like a human... no, there are traces of human scent on you, but it's almost gone."
"I..." Qingyi thought for a brief moment, looking at his own hands.
He remembered Xueyao saying something similar after he improved his lineage and, honestly, he was confused.
Lineages shouldn't change this kind of thing, not naturally and without using specific lineage techniques that allowed them to take on forms linked to their ancestors.
Qingyi had one of these techniques, the black dragon scales, but this technique should only affect him while he had it active.
The rest of the time, he was supposed to be like any other human, only with a much more powerful body and senses.
"Ah... it doesn't matter." The true immortal spoke, turning to the youngsters. "What are you waiting for, brats? Let's go back to the tribe! We have a guest."
"Yes, elder!" The young men shouted before disappearing into the forest, leaping through the trees with surprising agility.
After everyone had left, the True Immortal turned to Qingyi.
"Our tribe isn't generally hostile to visitors, quite the opposite, but you still smell of human blood. I need to know the reason for that."

"Of course, senior, this junior was in a battle before he ended up here after falling into a space trap, but I can assure you that I have no bad intentions. In fact, I intend to leave as soon as possible."
Qingyi spoke, drawing a gentle smile from the True Immortal.
"I believe you. It's rare that we have young dragons among us, so please accompany me. At least stay to watch the great hunt."
"Great hunt?" Qingyi asked, searching for that term in his mind.
"It's nothing anyone outside the lands of the, as you call us, 'beast men', should know." The True Immortal chuckled.

"In short, the youngest princess of our tribe has reached maturity and, as a great huntress, has asked for her husband to be chosen in a great hunt involving any young man who has the courage to try his luck and catch the best game."
"Ah... I understand..." Qingyi scratched his chin, walking alongside the immortal on the same trail that the other cat men had followed.
In the end, this was, or at least appeared to be, an extremely primitive civilization, although powerful enough to have so many young people in the realm of the false immortal.
Qingyi could only imagine how powerful the cultivation of the leader of this tribe would be. Perhaps an immortal emperor? Or something even more powerful than that?
Naturally, Qingyi was excited to meet such a powerful being.
"Won't you join in too?" The true immortal turned his face, his white feline ears twitching slightly as he sensed Qingyi's emotions.
His hearing was sensitive enough to sense Qingyi's heart racing slightly, his senses being sharper than Qingyi was even capable of imagining.
In the end, that was the cat people's main strength: incomparable reaction time and senses, barely inferior to those Qingyi gained from using his draconic eyes.
"Can outsiders join in too?" Qingyi asked.
"Yes, in fact, anyone whose cultivation is below the False Immortal realm and age is under 25 can join, regardless of their origin.
This is a competition to choose the most capable of the younger generation, after all."
"Well... I'll think about it..." Qingyi said, scratching his chin.
He couldn't make a decision without seeing this woman, could he? What if she was like the princess of the Blue Sea Kingdom?
Qingyi could even imagine having to run away from a crazy whale in the shape of a cat woman.
He didn't want that kind of headache in his life.
After a few more minutes of walking, the true immortal stopped his steps, as did Qingyi.
They already seemed to have reached their destination.

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - Linyue
paragraphs: Qingyi couldn't help but be shocked by the size of that 'tribal village', if it could be called that.
Its low density made it expand for miles, with primitive but strangely elegant wooden houses surrounding paths that seemed to shape themselves naturally, passing by streams and lakes.
From the small hill where they watched, Qingyi could see a large palace in the center, apparently fused to a tree that reached over five hundred meters high.
The skull of a colossal canid creature was entwined between its branches.
"Come on, I'll introduce you to a nice tavern. My name is Jin'Rao, by the way." The real immortal spoke, patting Qingyi on the back before skipping off towards the city.
The handsome young man couldn't help but feel a little uncomfortable.
Why on earth was Jin'Rao treating an outsider he had just met so well? Wasn't that a bit suspicious?
Qingyi reflected on this for a brief moment before shaking his head.
He was in a land far, far away from anything he knew. It was best, at least for the time being, to stay by Jin'Rao's side.
With a sigh, he too jumped, falling for a few hundred meters and landing on a small trail that soon opened up into a wide road.
It was lined with strangely organized tree branches, forming a dense pathway with no potholes, separating those walking on it from the muddy ground below.
As he entered the city, Qingyi immediately found himself surrounded by a mixture of smells, people and beasts the likes of which he had never seen before.
Honestly, the biggest surprise Qingyi got was seeing a voluptuous cat woman shouting a loud, high-pitched and cute "Nyan" after a man slapped her ass in a tavern.
The man's face was immediately torn apart by her sharp claws, whose face was full of rage.
About 95% of the population there were catfolk, but he could still see several other types of beast folk, even one who exuded a powerful draconic Qi and had a large pair of horns on his head.
The vast majority seemed to be young men looking to try and win the hand of the princess of the cat people's tribe.
Their clothing was much more refined than that of the catfolk, as was their manners. Although they were both part of the beast folk, they seemed to be from completely separate civilizations.
"Don't be surprised, we are a hunting people. We have never abandoned the tradition of our ancestors, nor will we, unlike many other folks." Jin'Rao spoke, noticing the look on Qingyi's face.
His tail wrapped around his own waist as he entered a tavern, dragging one of his sharp nails against the wood.
The next moment, a beautiful and elegant waitress appeared, carrying with her a tray full of beers in wooden mugs.

"Oh... Captain Jin'Rao! Who's the handsome?" The waitress smiled at Qingyi, her voice turning into a soft purr as she approached their table, her tail, blackened with white spots, swaying gently, rubbing against Qingyi's arm.
"A lost young man I met in the forest. Give us a good beer to wet our throats and have a little chat."
"Oh... interesting, nyan..." The waitress's eyes sparkled as she placed two beers on the counter, soon being forced to go and serve other customers.
The Cat Folk tribe was much busier than usual because of the great hunt and she had too many customers to be able to pay as much attention to Qingyi as she wanted.
"You can drink, this one's on me, hahaha" Jin'Rao laughed, patting the table before taking a big gulp of beer.
"Thank you for your kindness, Mr. Jin'Rao. I promise this junior will repay you when he gets the chance." Qingyi said, taking a big gulp, feeling the sweet liquid go down his throat.
It was tasty, much better than he'd expected from a place like this, inferior only to what Elize could do if she was interested in brewing beer.
"You don't have to worry about these things, young man. I was only raised by a father who gave me a good eye for people and the honor of always helping those in need."
Jin'Rao laughed, stretching slightly, his nails growing to many centimeters before retracting them again.
It was strange. They were no different from human nails, but they grew sharp and long whenever their bearer wanted them to.
"Now, why don't you tell me more about the outside world and-" Jin'Rao's voice was interrupted by a commotion outside, a loud rumbling echoing.
"Oh... looks like the princess has arrived from her latest hunt!" Jin'Rao stood up, a big smile taking over his face, his tail wagging excitedly.
"Come on, young man, this may be your first and only chance to see her, even from afar!" Jin'Rao said, getting up and leaving the tavern; Qingyi followed close behind.
When they left the place, Qingyi immediately saw a young woman walking down the street, a boar carcass that reached over ten meters in length floating right behind her.
Her beauty was a surprise, even to Qingyi, who had already seen countless incomparable beauties.
She was short, barely reaching Qingyi's chest, with short orange hair with pointed ends, decorated by a pair of orange ears, her insides carrying white, fluffy fur.
Behind her, her tail was the same color, a deep orange with a white tip.

Her skin was pale, slightly golden and her breasts were covered only by a small, baggy leather top, which left large parts of the paler, sun-touched skin of her huge tits visible, contrasting with the slightly tanned skin of the rest of her body.
A leather tribal thong covered her private parts, falling into the deep valley of her round, plump and shapely buttocks and between her thighs, surely her strongest point; thick, soft and powerful.

'Ah... these tribes really do have good taste in clothes...' Qingyi sighed, observing this woman from head to toe, from her beautiful, delicate face and deep green eyes to her incomparable thighs and lean, toned belly.
Glancing at her status screen, Qingyi's eyes lit up.
[Name: Linyue
Age: 18
Corruption: 0/100
Chastity: Intact
Lust: 3%
Talent: Great genius.
Reward: extremely high
Cultivation: Third stage of the false immortal realm.
Spiritual roots: Transcendent level wind spiritual root.
Lineage: Howling Sky Tiger Lineage (Sky Grade)
Constitution: Howling Sky Tiger Constitution (Sky Grade)
Traits: Faithful, great hunter, feline royalty, curious, cheeky, naughty, playful].
"Senior Jin'Rao... this junior thinks he'll want to take part in the great hunt."

"Simple, I'm going to take part in the great hunt! The best hunter will become my husband, right? Well, if I'm the best hunter, there won't be anyone to be my husband!"
Tai'Ren heard those words, his face taking on a slight frown before he sighed.
He even thought about speaking out against it, but he'd been that girl's father long enough to know that it was no use.
The moment she put that idea into his head, that was exactly what she would do.
"If you manage to defeat every one of our young hunters, I'll think about your case," Tai'Ren said, watching his daughter's face take on a deep glow.
"Now get ready, the event will start soon, you'll do the opening slaughter."
"Okay dad!" Linyue said, wiping the blood from her body, changing her clothes and finally running to her room, where her servants began the preparation for the opening slaughter.
Her body was covered in a soft, shiny paint, which strangely made her look even more sensual than before.
Her hair was carefully decorated, as were her robes and even her feline ears.
When she had finished, she gave a big smile, looking at herself in the mirror before following the servants.
Her appearance had to be covered by a veil and she was quickly taken from the city to the large central arena where the start of the event would be announced.
There were still a few hours to go, so she had to wait a while, spending her time throwing knives and eating some snacks she had prepared beforehand.

When the arena finally filled up and Linyue's sharp hearing picked up the sounds of the crowd outside, she stood up, preparing herself for a short moment before leaving the small place where she was standing.
She appeared on the large central platform of the arena, which seemed to have been carved out of stone, covering more than five square kilometers.
Although the great hunt only had around a thousand participants, that arena was now filled with more than two hundred thousand people, almost half of all the citizens of the Cat People tribe.
"Uh... Nyan..." Linyue inhaled before exhaling heavily, her eyes sweeping over those watching.
She could see many familiar gazes falling on her, from the rich young masters of her tribe to the powerful elders, all watching her with interest.
Suddenly, her brief gaze stopped, filled with a deep tremor as she caught the gaze of one of the many young men in the audience.
It was a burning, penetrating gaze, beautiful dark eyes that seemed to see beyond her soul, adorning a face of incomparable beauty.
Linyue looked away, a soft red spreading across her cheeks.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - The great Hunt (02)
paragraphs: Long Qingyi smiled as he saw Linyue's reaction, his eyes roaming over her curves, lingering on her thick, creamy thighs and her large, heavy breasts.
Unfortunately, something else soon took his attention as a lone figure appeared at the top of the stands, in one of the highest and most luxurious boxes.
It was a towering man with broad shoulders, white hair and feline ears marked by horrible scars.
Qingyi couldn't sense even a thread of Qi in that man, even when he activated his draconic eyes.
It was like a deep, endless darkness.
"Look... it's Patriarch Tai'Ren!"
"I've heard that he's at the peak of the ancestral emperor realm, one of the most powerful in the entire Beast Men Land!"
"So powerful!"
Murmurs echoed around Qingyi, who sighed.
So that was the father of his future wife. Qingyi hoped he was an open-minded man.
"It's good to see so many friendly faces here. Even after ten thousand years of life, none of my children has ever failed to make me a happy man, my dear Linyue will be no different.
The man who gets the best hunt today will be the one who marries my dear daughter. May the heavens bless you and may the great divine beast protect you."
The moment Tai'Ren's voice fell silent, a figure broke through the skies, falling to the ground with a crash powerful enough to make the whole arena shake.
It was a giant white tiger, its blue eyes carrying a deep glow as it advanced towards Linyue.
The voluptuous cat girl leapt up, her breasts swaying as her body spun in the air, the tiger's claws passing inches from her face.
The beast stumbled, its ten-ton body crashing to the ground.
Linyue didn't even seem to take the beast seriously, landing elegantly on its huge feline head and even clasping her hands behind her back.
The tiger could only roar angrily, spinning its body around and trying to swallow Linyue, only to find nothing but empty air.
Linyue was already beneath it, her nails extending into sharp claws, aiming for the tiger's paws.
In the next moment, the tiger went down, a pain-filled roar escaping as it collapsed under the weight of its own body.
Linyue then raised a single hand, a spear appearing in her grip.
Taking careful aim, she threw, and the spear tore through the air with absurd speed, landing exactly on the beast's temple, killing it.
Obviously, she could have done this from the start, without having to use her agility to humiliate the beast like that.
But in the end, it was a show. She also needed to cheer up the audience, which of course she did, with lots of excited shouts echoing all around.
She turned her face again, staring at that young man.
He was still watching her, with the same strength and intensity as before - no, with even more intensity.
Linyue looked away, patting her own face.
'Focus, this is no time to think about useless things!' she shouted in her own mind.
She was confused as to why she was reacting like that to that young man's gaze, but now she had something else in mind.
Qingyi just shook his head at the sight, smiling softly.
His eyes floated to his status screen, taking a look at his earnings.
[Name: Long Qingyi
Age: 21
Cultivation: First stage of the flowing meridian realm (15,000,000,000 lust points to upgrade)
Affinities: Lightning: 248 - Sword: 257 - Fire: 234 - Ice: 223 - Charm: 1000 (can be upgraded in the lust store)
Spiritual roots: Earth-level three-colored spirit root (Lightning sword, fire, ice) (10,000,000,000 lust points to upgrade, new roots can be bought in the lust store).
Lineage: Blood of the Corruption Dragon God (Gold grade, 10,000,000,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Constitution: Primordial Dragon Body (Gold grade, 10,000,000,000 lust points to upgrade.)
Lust points: 6,103,529,131]
That was all he had achieved in seven days just by farming lust points. Qingyi was honestly a little disappointed.
The lust points he had earned from Margareth had reached their minimum value and now he was just scrambling to get more.
At least he had managed to upgrade his spiritual root to earth level, something his wives would soon be able to do.
After all, Feiyan had finally reached a level where she could produce earth-grade spirit root, lineage and constitution enhancement pills pure enough for his wives to use safely.
In the meantime, she had naturally produced many pills that were good enough to sell, but far from usable for Qingyi's wives.
He was still thinking about how to get rid of those, but for now, he had something else to worry about.

"All those who will take part in the great hunt, ahead," Tai'Ren declared, watching as more than a thousand young people jumped into the arena. Only 50 of these were members of other races, all the others were cat people.
They lined up neatly, facing Tai'Ren. It only took them a brief moment to realize something.
Why on earth hadn't Linyue left the arena yet? What was she waiting for?
After a single second, everyone there began to realize: she was also going to take part in the hunt.
But why on earth would she do something like that? This was a hunt to find her next husband, what was the point of her taking part?
The young people's minds raced endlessly until they finally found a possibility; Linyue wanted to take first place and not let anyone else be her husband.
"Pay attention," Tai'Ren's voice snapped all the young people out of their stupor.
"From now on, the great hunt will begin. You will have the entire patriarch's forest to hunt and a total of twenty-four hours.
After twenty-four hours, the hunt will be over and anyone who hasn't arrived here within two hours will be disqualified.
I will judge the hunted beasts personally and first place will receive not only my daughter's hand in marriage, but also the chance to be personally instructed by me."
The moment Tai'Ren's voice fell silent, one of the arena's walls opened, revealing a large passageway that overlooked a dense forest.
"Begin!"

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - The great Hunt (03)
paragraphs: The moment the cat folk patriarch's voice fell, everyone there turned into blurs, running towards the forest.
Qingyi was the one with the lowest cultivation among all those young people, the only one below the enlightened soul realm.
Still, he didn't care, ignoring the powerful Qi's falling on him as he disappeared into the forest.
He ran non-stop for several minutes, quickly moving kilometers away from the city.
Fortunately, he had received some tips from Jin'Rao the previous morning and now had a better understanding of how this competition worked.
The beasts would be judged in three categories: size, breed, condition of the carcass and cultivation, the last being the most important.
Sighing, Qingyi began his search, activating his draconic eyes and leaping up to appear above the treetops.
Looking closely at his surroundings, he could see a myriad of auras and battles exploding many kilometers away, with powerful pulses of Qi reaching him.
With the Qi so violent, the spirit beasts in that region became agitated.
Even the nocturnal predators woke up, coming out in broad daylight to investigate what was happening.
Qingyi spotted many beasts until he finally found something that caught his eye.
A large black serpent, its body reaching over forty meters in length, big and heavy, exuded a dark Qi.It was only a beast of the enlightened soul realm, but Qingyi didn't care.
He drew the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword and advanced, his body turning into a bolt of lightning as he activated the lightning blink.
The great serpent suddenly raised its head. Its jaw opened into a mouth capable of swallowing a horse with ease, a sharp hiss spreading through the forest.
Before it could even react, Qingyi was already upon it, swinging the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword towards its long neck covered in black scales.
A loud metallic clang echoed, followed by a miserable hiss as the sword tore through the beast's scales, sinking into its soft flesh.
Its huge serpentine body twisted violently. Its jaw opened, squirting black poison all over the forest as it struggled, its Qi exploding uncontrollably.
Wherever the poison touched, a hot steam arose. Wood, leaves and even the soft earth of the forest floor turned into nothing but black goo.
A little of the poison hit Qingyi's chest, who flinched, but barely managed to damage his powerful body.
"Just a little more..." he muttered, looking at the snake's open neck.
His sword had only cut about twenty percent, far less than he wanted. Still, he was satisfied.

Readying the Heaven-Defying Thunder Sword, Qingyi attacked again. He used the second form of the Storm Monarch's Sword Art, a slash of Qi that tore through the air at absurd speed, landing exactly on the open wound.
This time, the snake couldn't resist. Qingyi's attack sank even deeper, tearing through bone, flesh and muscle, decapitating it in an explosion of blood.
The handsome young man landed next to the snake and touched its scales before sighing.
It wasn't a bad kill, but it was still honestly too weak. In addition, the carcass had also suffered a lot of damage, especially to its scales, which would further diminish the beast's value.
Sighing, Qingyi simply sent the carcass into the world of the mind. Feiyan would make some use of it and, if she couldn't, Elize certainly could.
Raising his head, he prepared to go elsewhere when he saw a figure pass by him, running towards the horizon.
Ten other figures followed soon after, all heading for one place.
Qingyi hesitated at first, but after a moment's thought, he decided to follow the crowd towards a mountain on the horizon.
He immediately sensed a clash between two Qi's that he knew well.
One belonged to an elegant young man with long white hair and horns as pure as snow on his head. The other, a cat-man of equal beauty, with dark ears and tail.
Both faced each other, releasing their auras unchecked, making the world around them tremble.
"The steel-shelled turtle will be mine, you bastard!" The young man with draconic blood roared, swinging his sword towards Lioran.
Lioran merely turned his body. The draconic-blooded young man's cut passed inches from his face, drawing a thin trickle of blood.

"Ah... to dare challenge me here, you truly have guts, don't you? Long Xuefeng." Lioran laughed, using his claws to launch small but sharp slashes of Qi towards Long Xuefeng, who defended himself with ease.
They both remained in a stalemate for a long moment before turning their faces, staring at those watching them.
Parasites looking for a chance to take advantage of Lioran and Xuefeng, ready to strike the moment they were weakened.
Exchanging glances, they turned towards those spectators.
"You have ten seconds to disappear," Lioran declared.
They wanted to kill each other, but they didn't want anyone to profit from their fight.
At first, no one moved, at least not until Lioran started counting.
When he reached four, half of them had already left, scattering into the forest.
Lioran stopped counting just before he reached eight, his eyes focusing on a lone figure, the only one who hadn't fled.
It was a young man who looked human, but smelled like a dragon, with a pure, deep aroma.
Sensing Qingyi's cultivation, Xuefeng laughed. "What? The little commoner in the flowing meridian realm thinks he has a chance? Hahahaha!"
"I'll get rid of this one, don't run away," Xuefeng spoke, taking a step towards Qingyi, his sword tearing through the air at absurd speed.
He expected to crush Qingyi easily, but that wasn't the case.
The moment his sword hit Qingyi's, the ground beneath his feet gave way in a deep crater. A shockwave swept through everything for dozens of meters, blowing off both their clothes.
Xuefeng could barely hide the shock on his face as he was thrown backwards, his back hitting the mountain with a thud.
Smiling, Qingyi stretched, watching Xuefeng and Lioran with a casual expression.
"How's it going to be, are the little couple going to come together, or do you want me to break your legs one by one?"

"Who the hell do you think you are to dare show such disrespect? Do you know who my father is?" Lioran roared, his face contorted with fury.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - Iron-shelled turtle
paragraphs: Linyue spun elegantly in the air, her claws leaving nothing but sharp marks on the turtle's shell.
Her feet hit the damp floor of the cave without making a sound and she watched that turtle coldly, a spear appearing in her hands.
Despite not having any wounds, she was panting, her fair sun-touched skin drenched in sweat, her tits rising and falling with each breath.
The beast gradually revealed its head to Linyue, a powerful black metallic Qi surrounding its body.
Slowly, small holes appeared in its shell and it hid its head again, sharp spines emerging from these small holes.
In the next moment, the giant steel-shelled turtle released all the thorns in an explosion, each one made of powerful metallic Qi.
Linyue gritted her teeth as she dodged, her face focused on the turtle, her body twirling elegantly in the air, her feet stepping on nothing and using it as momentum to dodge the attack.
After exactly fifteen seconds the attack stopped and Linyue was finally able to let a sigh of relief escape her full rosy lips, although she still didn't let her guard down.
Her short orange hair fluttered and her beautiful green eyes sparkled as she threw her spear, aiming for the small gap where the turtle's head had disappeared and its paws had failed to protect.
The attack was accurate, drawing a big smile from Linyue.
"Gotcha, you iron-headed nyan!" She gave an excited squeal as the iron-shelled turtle showed its head again, Linyue's spear lodged exactly in its right eye.
A heart-stopping roar escaped the turtle's open jaw as it thrashed about in pain, its Qi distorting violently, sending out powerful shockwaves and making the whole cave tremble.
Linyue already had another spear in her hands, ready to strike another blow, an even more powerful one this time.
But the voluptuous cat girl stopped at the last moment, noticing the turtle stalling, its remaining eye focused on her.
Suddenly, the turtle roared, its bestial face filled with rage as it threw itself towards Linyue.

The cat-girl could only dodge, her body turning into a blur before the place where she was standing was hit by the turtle's huge body, more than thirty tons of flesh and steel hitting the walls of the cave, which shuddered, collapsing on top of the turtle.
"Nyan... is it dead? How can I show this prey if I didn't kill it?" Linyue spoke, her face filling with panic.
She had known about that turtle in her father's private hunting territory for a long time and she was sure it would be better than any other prey her opponents could even imagine.
But if the turtle had died in the collapse... how could she claim the kill?
Of course, there was nothing to stop her from simply taking the turtle one way or another, but that wasn't what she had learned from her father.
Suddenly, an explosion echoed, filling Linyue's face with relief.
The turtle was intact, the stones covering it being thrown into the sky as its huge body re-emerged from among the rubble, still as crazed as before, throwing itself at Linyue again.

The voluptuous cat-girl could only keep dodging, occasionally picking up a spear from her spatial ring and hurling it towards the turtle, which was getting more and more tired, its huge reserves of Qi soon beginning to fail.
However, the moment before Linyue struck the final blow, something changed.
The turtle's Qi suddenly exploded, changing from a silvery black to a reddish, putrid black, a horrible smell spreading throughout the cave.
At that moment, Linyue couldn't react in time, her body overcome with shock.
She threw her spear to the ground, raising her arms and forming a thick barrier of Qi between her and the steel-shelled turtle.
Yet it wasn't enough, her body being thrown backwards like a cannonball, hitting the cave walls with a thud.
She was barely able to avoid an internal injury, her eyes focusing only to find the turtle advancing towards her again, seeking to crush her against the wall.
She closed her eyes, the fur on her tail and ears standing up in terror of an impact that never came.
When she opened her eyes again, she realized something; the turtle had stopped and right between her and the turtle, there was a figure.
It was a young man of incomparable beauty, his feet sinking into the ground as his powerful arms stopped the advance of the thirty-ton beast, his long black hair fluttering with the impact.
It was Long Qingyi, the same young man who had caught her eye in the stands.
The handsome young man gritted his teeth, his muscles burning as he threw the steel-shelled turtle backwards, immediately reaching out his hand, a lance of flame appearing in his grip.
The turtle was almost flipped onto its back, landing violently a few dozen meters away from Qingyi.
Before it could even hide its head again, the lance of flame was already falling on it, hitting its open mouth and exploding.
Even though the turtle hadn't suffered much external damage, the explosion still spread to the inside of its body, tearing its innards and causing it to violently vomit blood.
Qingyi walked over to it in slow, light steps, jumping on its head and wielding the heaven-defying thunder sword.
Without hesitation, he plunged it into the turtle's head, using his lightning Qi to slowly melt the thin steel plates that protected even that place.

They were resistant, although incomparable to the armor of its shell. Fortunately, Qingyi's lightning Qi was still much stronger than enough to get through it, the heaven-defying thunder sword reaching the turtle's brain, killing its body and destroying its soul.
Sighing, Qingyi turned his face, observing the crimson-black energy leaving that turtle, smelling that terrible odor.
That Qi was strangely familiar, crimson, putrid and corrosive, something that shouldn't exist.
That was, or at least looked very much like, demonic Qi.
Naturally, such a possibility made Qingyi's blood run hot. Those bastards were even there?
Well, it was kind of obvious, the immortal heaven was much closer to the celestial heaven, where true demons dwelled.

paragraphs: Despite having had little chance to talk to Tai'Ren, the leader of the cat folk, Qingyi still formed a strong impression of him just by observing how he treated the other youngsters.

Even though he had already declared Long Qingyi the champion of the great hunt, Tai'Ren still took the time to analyze each of them's hunts, personally handing out rewards and giving them a strong squeeze on the shoulder.
He didn't even seem to mind his elevated position in relation to them.
Linyue, walking beside Qingyi, gave him a sidelong glance, briefly admiring his now even more beautiful and penetrating eyes before looking away.
"What are you thinking about, huh?" Qingyi asked, stroking her head and pulling her into an embrace, his hand coming down on her right breast, squeezing gently.
At first she resisted a little, but soon gave in with a soft purr, clinging to his arm that gripped her boob, her nails leaving deep marks on Qingyi's pale skin.
"Nyan... nghnn~~" She moaned softly, her feline ears twitching gently. "You're lucky I didn't manage to capture you. I'm sure Father would give me the victory if I had a pleasure demon as prey!"
"Ah... would you really condemn your future husband to such a horrible death?" Qingyi asked, placing a soft kiss on her lips.
"Yes, Nyan!" She gave an excited shout, drawing a sigh of defeat from him.
She spoke with such certainty that Qingyi could hardly tell if she was joking or not.
After a few more moments, Linyue led him to the highest part of the huge palace, in front of a steel door.
"Just go up. Father is waiting outside. I'll take care of the prey I caught this morning, hehehe," she giggled before leaving cheerfully.
Hesitating briefly, Qingyi opened the door, entering a seemingly endless staircase that climbed up the trunk of the thick tree that the palace was built around.
He climbed for several minutes, counting more than a thousand steps until he finally reached the top, next to the enormous skull of a canid creature.
In front of this creature's skull stood an imposing and powerful figure, his broad, strong shoulders decorated with the skin of a tiger as a cape.
Tai'Ren turned around, a gentle smile taking over his manly, scarred face.
"Long Qingyi greets father-in-law," Qingyi put his fists together, bowing respectfully.

"I can see that you have made great progress in understanding your lineage and affinities. Congratulations." Tai'Ren slapped Qingyi hard on the shoulder, a small pulse of Qi coursing through the young man's body.
Qingyi barely had time to react, let alone resist that pulse of Qi.
After a short moment, Tai'Ren showed a satisfied expression and gestured with his hands.
Two chairs and a small table appeared next to it, with a bottle of expensive liquor and two glasses already on it.
"Have some with your father-in-law, son-in-law," Tai'Ren said, serving himself and Qingyi, who sat on the opposite side of the small table.
"Do you know which beast this is?" Tai'ren asked Qingyi, although he already knew the answer.
"No, father-in-law." Qingyi shook his head.
"It's a divine beast, but not the ancestral divine beast, not the one that gave birth to our people. Just a type of beast that is above even the mythical beasts."
Qingyi couldn't hide a trace of surprise on his face. "Don't these only exist in the celestial heaven?"
"Yes, they should only exist in the celestial sky. Yet three of them existed here." Tai'Ren took a long sip of liquor.
"One was killed by my ancestor in a coalition with the ancestors of many other peoples, another by the ancestor of the dragon people, and the last by the ancestor of the fox people."
"This was the three-eyed scarlet divine wolf, killed over a million years ago. A being whose power would be enough to level the entire immortal heaven if it existed today.
"I see... but why is father-in-law telling me this?" Qingyi asked, taking a sip of the liquor, feeling the strong taste dominate his tongue.

"No particular reason. I've just heard that you're interested in the divine beast tournament to have a chance of contacting the fox people. That would be good to know if that's your goal." Tai'Ren stood up and walked to the edge of the colossal branch where they were standing.
"I also heard that you come from the outside lands and that one of the Gold King's daughters is already your wife. Do you plan to take Linyue from this place with you?"

Qingyi hesitated briefly, but decided that there was no point in lying to someone like Tai'Ren. "Yes, father-in-law. I plan to leave as soon as I've settled everything I have to settle with the fox people."
Honestly, he was a little surprised at how much Tai'ren already knew about him, but it was understandable.
As the leader of a powerful people, Tai'Ren naturally had many informants in every corner of his territory.
The moment he chose Qingyi, he probably sent his spies to collect every piece of information available about him.
Qingyi expected an angry reaction, but to his surprise, Tai'Ren just smiled.
"Very well. That child never liked the idea of staying here for the rest of her life. But first, I need to make sure you can protect her. What do you say we start our lesson?"
Hearing these words, Qingyi remembered another reward for placing first in the great hunt: a day of martial arts lessons with Tai'Ren himself, a cultivator of the ancestral emperor realm.
He was so focused on Linyue that he barely remembered this reward, but now he realized that it was an excellent opportunity to strengthen himself even more.
Without even giving Qingyi time to respond, Tai'Ren used his Qi to grab him and, with one smooth movement, leapt into the sky, flying at absurd speed, breaking the sound barriers several times.
"Come on, son-in-law! Don't you dare die in that little fall!" Tai'Ren roared, flying thousands of meters high and throwing Qingyi towards the ground.

"Hm..." Tai'Ren scratched his chin, his frown deepening.
"So you're asking me, Tai'Ren, to go back on my word?"
Tai'Ren honestly didn't like Elder Lu very much.

Firstly, because the old man was already on the verge of advancing to the ancestral emperor realm, at only 2,000 years old, he had a high chance of reaching the peak of the ancestral emperor realm if his advancement in a few hundred years' time was successful.
With the possibility of achieving such power, Elder Lu had already started plotting.
"Not at all, patriarch!
I just want you to understand what's best for our people!
Linyue needs a man to match!" Elder Lu spoke, bringing his fists together.
Before Tai'Ren was even able to reply, he saw a figure rise up beside him.
It was his eldest son, who had just advanced to the realm of the Immortal Emperor, one of Tai'Ren's greatest prides.
"Father, I agree with Elder Lu.
What will become of us if we hand someone like Linyue over to some outsider?"
"Hmm..." Tai'Ren grunted with dissatisfaction, his anger leaking out slightly as he stood up.
Now that he had taken a real liking and respect for Qingyi, naturally hearing his own son say that left him with a bitter taste in his mouth.
Tai'Ren was about to give his verdict when he turned his face to his son-in-law, observing his eyes full of coldness, their purple color glowing softly, as if they could penetrate a man's soul.
"Long Qingyi, do you have anything to say?" Tai'Ren asked.
"Yes, father-in-law." Qingyi stood up, staring at Elder Lu coldly.
"For Elder Lu to judge me like this, I suppose he's completely sure that I'm not worthy, isn't he?"
"You're not." Elder Lu smiled.
"Well then, duel me, suppress your cultivation to my level, no, to a level above mine and fight me.
If you defeat me, I'll leave immediately and never set eyes on Linyue again, but if you lose..." Qingyi's voice suddenly lowered, turning into a growl dripping with murderous intent.
"Your son must be castrated."
"What insolence!" Elder Lu slammed his hand against the table.
His son, Lioran, couldn't help but shudder, feeling a chill run through his private parts.
Qingyi really wasn't thinking of doing something like that, was he?
Did he think a cultivator at the peak of the Immortal Emperor was anything?
Even Linyue felt her heart plummet, her lips trembling softly.
Just when she was starting to like Qingyi... why on earth wouldn't he just let her father sort it out?
Linyue cast a hopeful glance at her father, hoping that he wouldn't allow such a proposal.
Unfortunately, that wasn't the case - quite the opposite.
Her father had an expression of pure delight on his masculine, brutish face, the powerful muscles in his arms tensing as he clenched his fists.
'THIS!
This is how a man should be, fighting his own battles, protecting his wife's honor and fearing no enemy, regardless of the difference in cultivation!
I truly have an exemplary son-in-law!'
Tai'Ren repeated proudly in his mind.
Obviously, he didn't let it show, taking the position of an impartial leader.
"Elder Lu, would you agree to such a duel?" Tai'Ren asked, clearing his throat.
"Of course I would, this boy needs to be taught some manners!"
"Very well, we'll interrupt dinner and the duel will take place right now, but I will personally seal Elder Lu's cultivation and this duel will be to the death." Tai'Ren declared.
That was honestly good even for him, especially if Qingyi was able to kill Elder Lu.
Tai'Ren would be rid of an annoying fly and the position of his son-in-law that gave him so much pride would be completely secure.
Naturally, everyone there shuddered when they heard those words, especially Elder Lu.
Duel to the death...
Was Tai'Ren really so confident in that young man?
Elder Lu hesitated for a brief moment, but in the end just swept those thoughts from his mind.
It was impossible... he was in the Immortal Emperor realm, below only the patriarch and a handful of elders.
Even if Qingyi's lineage was as powerful as Lioran said it was, Elder Lu was still absolutely certain of his victory.
In the end, he too had a powerful lineage, as well as thousands of years of experience.
His black tail moved gently from side to side as an evil smile appeared on his aged face.
"All right, young man, if you want to die that badly, I'll give you death!"

chapters.title: Chapter 350 - The fight
paragraphs: Elder Lu looked strangely at the area where Tai'Ren had decided the battle would take place.
They were in the middle of the forest, not in the great arena of the cat folk... why?
He looked at Tai'Ren, who was now surrounded by the elders, from the strongest to the weakest.
They were all speaking out against the duel, some even giving their direct support to Qingyi and Linyue's marriage.
However, none of them managed to convince Tai'Ren.
After pushing all the elders away, Tai'Ren walked up to Elder Lu and placed his hand on the old man's Dantian.
Elder Lu didn't resist, he just closed his eyes as dozens of restrictions fell on his cultivation.
His aura was quickly suppressed to a fraction of what it was before.
His cultivation was now reduced to the power of the enlightened soul realm, exactly one realm above Qingyi's.
He would even have liked to be in the same realm as Qingyi, but if the young man was so confident of defeating him being one cultivation realm below, then so be it.
Elder Lu raised his face, staring at Qingyi who was watching him coldly.
"You can still run away, young man. Cripple your own cultivation and I promise to forget about your audacity," he said calmly, observing the look of scorn on Qingyi's face.
"That won't be necessary, little cuckold Lu. Your granddaddy here is confident." Qingyi flashed a big smile.

"Little cuckold? granddaddy? You... damned brat!" The calm expression on Elder Lu's face disappeared, his frown deepening as he roared. "I'll rip out that arrogant tongue of yours and feed it to the pigs!"
Qingyi only laughed at those words, an expression of pure disdain taking over his handsome face. "Your wife certainly has strange tastes in food."
Those last words were the last straw for Elder Lu. His power exploded into a powerful aura, his robes fluttering as he pointed his hand at Qingyi.
In the next moment, a powerful palm Qi appeared, growing to over ten meters in length, flying towards Qingyi with terrifying power.
The handsome young man reciprocated with another palm, this one of ice Qi. It was less powerful because it wasn't a technique, just a clumsy release of Qi.
Even so, Qingyi had no problem dealing with that attack. The heaven-defying thunder sword slid out of its sheath with a loud, sharp metallic hiss.
Covered in a powerful thunderous Qi, it easily cut Elder Lu's palm strike in two, forcing him to retreat, a flaming spear immediately slicing through the air towards him.
'Ice, fire, lightning sword...' Elder Lu repeated in his mind, his body turning at a strange angle as he dodged Qingyi's spear.
A three-colored spirit root.
He already had an idea that Qingyi possessed all these types of Qi, but observing it with his own eyes was something completely different.
Especially when he considered the Qis of ice and fire - how could Qingyi's body not explode with all that?
Elder Lu gritted his teeth, feeling that bitter feeling in his heart.
He was a two-thousand-year-old expert. Qingyi was just a youngster who hadn't blossomed yet and would soon die.
He shouldn't be feeling this way about Qingyi.
"Die!" Elder Lu attacked again, his sharp claws sending dozens of slashes of Qi towards Qingyi.
The handsome young man only defended himself.
The heaven-defying thunder sword cut through the air beside his body with absurd speed and power, shattering Elder Lu's Qi attacks one after the other until the very last one.
At this attack, Qingyi was forced to retreat. The air formed a vacuum around him as a powerful shockwave spread.
The ground cracked for dozens of meters as he was pushed backwards, his feet opening a deep crack in the ground.
"Ah... little cuckold Lu has finally decided to take his granddaddy seriously?" Qingyi smiled, spitting on the ground.
"Shut up!" Elder Lu leapt into the air, retracting his arms, his palm Qi gathering in his hands as he prepared himself.
The next moment, he attacked, two twin palms tearing through the air with tremendous speed, falling on Qingyi as if trying to crush an insect.
Qingyi didn't stand still either.
He prepared the heaven-defying thunder sword, using the first form of the Tempest Monarch sword art, pushing every drop of Qi he still had in his Dantian into that attack.

Despite his words, he truly didn't dare despise Elder Lu. After all, even with his cultivation sealed, he was still an Immortal Emperor and his raw power was no less than that of an expert in the False Immortal realm like Qingyi.
"Die, you filthy brat!" Elder Lu's roar echoed like thunder through the skies as his attack fell on the ethereal, thundering blade tip that formed in front of Qingyi's sword.
"You really ended up with a great husband, daughter, hahaha." Tai'Ren laughed, stroking Linyue's head as she watched the battle.
The beauty just flashed a big smile, turning her face towards Lioran and sticking out her tongue at him.
"Looks like someone's going to lose their little eggs, hehehe," she giggled, covering her lips with her small, delicate hands.
Lioran just gritted his teeth, his whole body trembling as he watched the clash between Qingyi and his father.
Their attacks had simply stopped in mid-air.
Qingyi's lightning Qi was sent towards the ground, destroying everything within a radius of tens of meters, opening deep, blackened rips.
Elder Lu's Qi, on the other hand, was launched into the sky, piercing the dark clouds and painting them gold.
It was a beautiful scene, but it soon had to end.
Elder Lu gave it his all, gritting his teeth, roaring and shouting.
But in the end, he coughed up a trickle of blood as he tried to pull out some of the Qi that was blocked, his internal injuries accumulating more and more.
The flow of Qi that kept his attack active broke and the first form of the tempest Monarch's sword art only needed a single moment to shatter the golden palm.
